That's it for side quests, so let's visit the final area in Asia, Kuihai Tower.
Make sure to SAVE before entering!

  NOTE     If you need a bit of extra cash, see the beginning of the next
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   section, where you can find a Third Key that you can sell.

  NOTE     Except for weapons / armor / caps / belts, which are assumed as
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   obvious missables as they are replaced by stronger versions, there
           are two pieces of equipment that you need to buy now if you ever
           plan on getting them, as they're only available in Asia. Once you
           finish Kuihai Tower, you'll never be able to get them again, so make
           sure to buy as many as you want/need NOW. These items are...

           - Brigand Earrings (Shanghai, Huayuan) (I recommend purchasing 6)
           - Pirate Earrings (Shanghai, Huayuan) (I recommend purchasing 5)

Before climbing the stairs, open the visible chest on the stairs to the left
for a [_SEAL OF LIFE_], then open the second not-so-visible chest on the
opposite side for a [_THIRD KEY_]. If you wanted to buy something but was short
on cash, you now have an extra 15,000+ Cash available if you sell this, once
again.

Once you have both of those, start climbing the central staircase and attempt
to enter the Yawang Gate, where you'll have to take on another Yamaraja!

      .————————————.
     / *** BOSS *** \

|        | Studded Harness   | Studded Harness   | Studded Bustier   |        |

|  Note that Yamaraja: Stone is actually a FIRE class, so Man Dragon will be  |
|  your go-to Fusion if you're taking the magic route.                        |
|                                                                             |
|  Other than the fact that he uses defensive spells (that don't seem to      |
|  help him at all), all he'll use are physical attacks. They're not TOO      |
|  strong, but if he focuses on just one person on two different attacks,     |
|  he'll whittle their HP down quicker than you realize, so stay healed.      |
|                                                                             |
|  Have Yuri either fuse into the Man Dragon and blast him continuously with  |
|  Flash Flood, or just fuse into the Raging Tiger or Inferno (with Fighting  |
|  Spirit) and hammer away at him with physical attacks. Zhuzhen should be    |
|  continually casting Life Sucker, and Margarete should use Aqua Edge on     |
|  Yuri first (if he's attacking), then have her use Snipe continuously.      |
|  Zhuzhen will probably be doing the least amount of damage, so have him on  |
|  healing duty when HP starts to drop. This Yamaraja is fairly easy          |
|  compared to the last two bosses.                                           |
|                                                                             |

     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

After the battle, you'll receive the [_B. TORTOISE VP_], and you'll
automatically enter the Tower. On the center platform is a Save Point, so be
sure to use it. You should see a chest directly beside the Save Point, but on
the other side, so run clockwise until you reach the chest containing a
[_LOTTERY TICKET_]. From the remaining two staircases here, go up the eastern
one, following the path to the next area.

        Up on the next floor, examine the area just to the upper-left of the stairs,
where you'll find a place to insert the B. Tortoise VP. Choose to put it in,
then choose "the Black Tortoise" to place the picture in its place. After doing
that, check the far left side of the room to find a [_PURE EXTRACT_], then
enter the newly unlocked door on the right side of the room. Out here, follow
the path to the next area, then at the end of the path, open the chest for a
[_B. DRAGON VP_]. Once you have it, head back down to the first area with the
Save Point.

  NOTE     If you're still in need of Cash at this point, the Pure Extract
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   sells for 10,000 Cash. Just sayin'.

From the Save Point, stay on the platform you're currently on and take the
northwestern path to the next area. Go to the left side of the room and look on
the ground beneath the artwork to find an.... [_EROTIC BOOK_]. Oh LàLà...?
OH LÀLÀ?!?! ( For all of you Back to the Future nuts like me. ;D ) It's a copy
of "Shanghai Angels"... Make sure to grab this, as it'll come in very handy
much later in the game. If you don't grab it, you'll definitely regret it.

In any case, while you're here, make sure examine the altar in the right-center
of the room to find a votive picture. Choose to take it, and you'll receive the
[_R. PHOENIX VP_]. Re-examine the altar here and choose to insert "the Blue
Dragon" into its place. Make your way back to the Save Point.

Take the last path that we haven't taken yet: the western staircase. Once
you're on the next floor up, examine the altar above you and choose to insert
"the Red Phoenix" into the hole there. Ignore the locked gate to your east for
now, and enter the newly unlocked door to the next area. Open the chest here
for the [_W. TIGER VP_], and since we're now at a dead-end, make your way back
to the Save Point.

Take the path northwest of the Save Point once again to the room where we found
the Erotic Book. Choose to take out the B. Dragon VP and replace it with "the
White Tiger" to have the correct one in its place. Make your way back to the
Save Point for the last time. Examine the altar here in the center of the room
and choose to insert "the Blue Dragon" to solve the puzzle here.

Make your way back up the western stairs, and go through the door you unlocked.
There is now a Save Point here; prepare for a battle, and Save. When you're
ready, go up the stairs on the right to the next area for a scene. Just a bit
after, you'll have a sub-boss battle.

      .————————————.
     / * SUB-BOSS * \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Badger Devil          |   700 HP  | Class: Fire  | [_] Seal of Luck         |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|                                                                             |
|  The Badger Devil uses a Fire Ball attack that doesn't hit for much damage  |
|  at all, and a physical attack that hits for a slightly decent amount.      |
|  Either way, it's not much to worry about.                                  |
|                                                                             |
|  The Badger Devil is susceptible to Instant Death, so do one of the         |
|  following two things:                                                      |
|                                                                             |
|  1) Fuse Yuri into the Death Emperor and cast Dark Messenger. Make sure to  |
|     hit the small red "Perfect!!" area, and voilà! Dead-dead-deadski.       |
|                                                                             |
|  2) Have Margarete use her Snipe ability. Make sure to hit the small red    |
|     "Perfect!!" area, and BAM!!! History.                                   |
|                                                                             |
|  If you're lucky, one of the first two steps will kill it. Sadly, it        |
|  doesn't ALWAYS work.                                                       |
|                                                                             |
|  If you don't have luck with either of those, no worries; he's still easy.  |
|  Have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger or Inferno (with Fighting Spirit)     |
|  and hammer away at him with physical attacks. Zhuzhen should be            |
|  continually casting Life Sucker, and Margarete should use Aqua Edge on     |
|  Yuri first, then have her use Snipe continuously. He'll fall quickly.      |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   01000 EXP   / \   00600 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

After the battle, check just to your right near the glowing light for a
[_LOTTERY TICKET_]. Continue southeast to open the door here, which is the
locked door near the eastern stairs from earlier. Also, descend the stairs just
below where you entered, and you'll find the chest behind the gate that we
ignored earlier. Open it for a [_TALISMANOFWISDOM_]. Once you have that, make
your way back to the last Save Point and SAVE YOUR GAME.

  NOTE     This is your point of no return. If there's ANYTHING else you wish
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   to do in Asia, now's the time. Once you proceed with the next
           battle, you won't be able to go back. Also, make sure that you have
           fought all four Evil enemies in the Graveyard for your
           Monster Library.

When you're absolutely ready, go back to where you fought the Badger Devil and
climb the steps to the west. Watch the events unfold, then take on Dehuai
himself.

      .————————————.
     / *** BOSS *** \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Dehuai                |  1700 HP  | Class: Fire  | [_] Hermit's Staff       |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|        .———————————————————.———————————————————.———————————————————.        |
|        |     Yuri [22]     |                   |   Margarete [20]  |        |
|        |                   |    Zhuzhen [19]   |                   |        |
|        |===================|===================|===================|        |
|        | Hand Needle       | Pilgrim's Staff   | Nanbu Pistol      |        |
|        | Studded Harness   | Studded Harness   | Studded Bustier   |        |
|        | Mind's Eye        | Face Guard        | Studded Cap       |        |
|        | Jade Lariat       | Coral Lariat      | Western Belt      |        |
|        | Western Belt      | Voodoo Doll       | Weird Bottle      |        |
|        |                   |                   |                   |        |
|        | Man Dragon        |                   |                   |        |
|        | Raging Tiger      |                   |                   |        |
|        | Inferno           |                   |                   |        |
|        '———————————————————'———————————————————'———————————————————'        |
|                                                                             |
|  Another Fire-based boss? Don't mind if I do! Makes Margarete that much     |
|  more useful!                                                               |
|                                                                             |
|  Dehuai's fire attacks, Magnard and Blaze, will hit your whole party for    |
|  decent damage, and he also has a rather quick (and interestingly bizarre)  |
|  physical attack that also does decent to major damage. He also has a Fast  |
|  Ring attack that hits for decent damage, and it can possibly make your     |
|  Judgment Ring spin faster. Make sure to keep healed and try to keep that   |
|  Ring status off!                                                           |
|                                                                             |
|  Have Yuri either fuse into the Man Dragon and blast him continuously with  |
|  Flash Flood, or just fuse into the Raging Tiger or Inferno (with Fighting  |
|  Spirit) and hammer away at him with physical attacks. Zhuzhen should be    |
|  continually casting Life Sucker, and Margarete should use Aqua Edge on     |
|  Yuri first (if he's attacking), then have her use Snipe continuously.      |
|  Zhuzhen will probably be doing the least amount of damage, so have him on  |
|  healing duty when HP starts to drop. He's pretty easy as well, but the     |
|  challenge is upcoming.                                                     |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   03500 EXP   / \   07000 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

After the battle and series of events, you'll regain control, and you'll get to
choose your party. I recommend keeping your current party of Yuri, Zhuzhen, and
Margarete, as Alice won't be of much help in the next boss battle. Make sure to
equip the Hermit's Staff on Zhuzhen that you won in the last battle. When you
regain control, head back down to the previous floor and SAVE YOUR GAME.

Once you've saved, go back to the upper floor and talk to the Japanese soldier
on the left. He will offer to change your party, in case you've changed your
mind, but if you choose to not change it, then you'll also find out that he's a
Lottery Member!

               /        (Yellow)  |  Star Swallow              \
              /      (Turquoise)  |  Soul Benediction           \
             /           (Green)  |  Pure Seed                   \
            /            (White)  |  Tissues                      \
           /$$$$ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _|_ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ $$$$\

The ring here moves fast, so remember, equipping the Pocket Watch will make it
easier to hit the areas! Make sure to win the Warlock Earrings before
continuing on; it increases your S-Atk up 20%, but will also increase the
damage received from S-Atks by 20%! If you don't win it, reload your last save
and try again. Remember, you need to win something from each member at least
once!

The Japanese Soldier to the right has items for sale. The next boss uses both
Petrification and Silence, so either equip Zodiac and Cosmic Bracelets on
everyone, or buy three each of the Bell Bracelets and Mirror Bracelets that
this guy has for sale, as well as any healing items you may need.

  NOTE     Just to let you know, two of your party members will be temporarily
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   leaving after these events, but not to worry; their accessories will
           automatically be put back into your inventory, so no worries.

Once you're ready, climb to the top of the tower. SAVE YOUR GAME here, then
keep going to meet up with Dehuai for the last time.

     / *** BOSS *** \

|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|        .———————————————————.———————————————————.———————————————————.        |
|        |     Yuri [22]     |                   |   Margarete [21]  |        |
|        |                   |    Zhuzhen [20]   |                   |        |
|        |===================|===================|===================|        |
|        | Hand Needle       | Hermit's Staff    | Nanbu Pistol      |        |
|        | Studded Harness   | Studded Harness   | Studded Bustier   |        |
|        | Warlock Earrings  | Face Guard        | Western Belt      |        |
|        | Bell Bracelet     | Bell Bracelet     | Bell Bracelet     |        |
|        | Mirror Bracelet   | Mirror Bracelet   | Mirror Bracelet   |        |
|        |                   |                   |                   |        |
|        | Heaven's Fiend    |                   |                   |        |
|        | Raging Tiger      |                   |                   |        |
|        | Inferno           |                   |                   |        |
|        '———————————————————'———————————————————'———————————————————'        |
|                                                                             |
|  Yamaraja will most likely start off with the Crimson Flame spell, dealing  |
|  MAJOR fire damage to your party and possibly Silencing them as well. His   |
|  Petrification attack should only do medium damage to your party IF you're  |
|  protected against it; otherwise, you'll turn to stone, and three           |
|  Petrified party members equals a game over. He'll also use a Shockwave     |
|  attack, but it only does a small amount of damage to your whole party.     |
|  His physical attacks are nothing to sneeze at either; a series of three    |
|  attacks will do MAJOR damage to a party member.                            |
|                                                                             |
|  As much as I hate to say this, Yuri will need to be the primary healer of  |
|  this battle, as he's the only one that has a heal-all spell, and without   |
|  it, it will be hard to keep up with the healing with just two party        |
|  members. Fuse him into the Heaven's Fiend, then cast Sacred Remedy if      |
|  your party needs healing, and if they don't, then use Exorcist Arrow.      |
|  Zhuzhen should be constantly casting Life Sucker, and Margarete should be  |
|  using Snipe. When the party's MP starts getting low, have Margarete use    |
|  Mana Seeds to boost them back up.                                          |
|                                                                             |
|  Due to the sheer amount of HP Yamaraja has, and the fact that your main    |
|  damage dealer is on healing duty, prepare for a very long battle. You'll   |
|  most likely need to use at least two Pure Seeds to keep Zhuzhen's and      |
|  Margarete's SP up.                                                         |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   06000 EXP   / \   11000 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

After the battle, watch the long and depressing series of events. That'll be it
for Asia; you'll be asked to save your game, so do so. Next, you'll be in
Europe.

your party, with only one available destination: Prague.

You'll gain control of Alice in Prague. Start heading north, but hug the right
side of the area. Before Alice reappears, you should see a '?' icon; examine
here to find a [_ZODIAC BRACELET_]. Go north to the next area and use the Save
Point you see here. Once you've saved, talk to the sleeping guy here, and
you'll find out that he's a Lottery Member!

The ring here EXTREMELY SLOW, so it should be VERY easy to get whatever you
want! Make sure to win the Brsrkr Earrings before continuing on; it increases
your max HP 20%! If you don't win it, reload your last save and try again.
Remember, you need to win something from each member at least once!

Keep following along the path past the bar, but before going to the next area,
step off to the right onto the raised platform near the building at the top of
the screen. Search the south end of the platform to find a [_KIRIN SCALE_],
then go north to the next area. Check behind the tree to your left, and you
should find a chest containing a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. Once you have it, go back
to the last area and enter the bar.

  NOTE     Save your shopping until the next town, since we'll get a better
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Guild Card there. Unless, of course, you absolutely need healing
           items and such.

Examine the table above the woman on your left (Peddler Rosa) to find a
[_PRIEST'S WINE_], then talk to Peddler Rosa to have Zhuzhen come back out.
Talk to him to progress the story, and when you regain control, head north to
the castle walls, where you'll encounter a new foe and have to face some of her
monsters.

After you defeat them, you'll be back in the bar. Grab anything you absolutely
need from the peddler here, then leave the bar. If for some reason you want to
talk to Meiyuan for some Acupuncture or want something from the Silent Peddler,
both are now at the north end of town. When you're finished, leave Prague. Head
to our next destination: Bistritz.

Take a few steps southwest to be back on the first screen, then check the
ground near the left stone pillar to find a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. Now make your
way back into the village, and use the Save Point if you wish. Go to the
northwest part of the area and search the somewhat hidden area to the right of
the church to find a [_MANA SEED_]. Head east to the next area, then make your
way all the way to the right; there's a [_TALISMANOFWISOM_] in the northeast
corner near the gate.

Once you have those items, check the door to the house to the southeast, where
a little girl will ask if you're her dad.

——————————————————————————————————————
   [1] No, it's a monster
   [2] I'm a friend of your father.
——————————————————————————————————————

Choose 2 to be let inside, where you'll have some dialogue with Terry's family.
Afterward, you'll regain control outside, and will have to do battle with
monsters randomly, as the fog is red. Head west back to the first area.

  NOTE     Examining the first door to the north here to will give you access
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   to the weapon shop. Again, hold off just a bit until we get that
           Guild Card.

Examine the door to the house in the northwestern corner for a scene, then go
back to the eastern side of town. Check the doors to the houses to the north
for some dialogue, then go back into the southeastern house for a long scene,
where you'll receive the [_EAST GATE KEY_].

Before leaving, check the floor at the bottom-right of the screen near the
barrels and boxes for a [_MOON SWALLOW_], then open a somewhat hidden chest on
the right side of the room for the [_MOON CARD_]. If you like, shop with Nina
for some items, and make sure to stop by the weapons shop to upgrade Alice's
and Zhuzhen's equipment. When you're ready, go to the eastern side of the
village and examine the eastern gate. Unlock it?

——————————————————————————————————————————
   [1] No, I don't want to leave.
   [2] Yes, go through the east forest.
——————————————————————————————————————————

Choose 2 to unlock the gate and proceed. Out here on the World Map, enter the
Blue Castle.

¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Go into the dark area in the set of trees to your left and look around; you
should find a [_COSMIC BRACELET_] behind a tree there. Once you have it, head
all the way north to the next area. Hug the right wall as you go north to be in
a small area with Meiyuan and a chest containing a [_THERA SEED_]. Check just
to the west of the other chest to find another chest, this one with a
[_STAR SWALLOW_].

Go back to the main path and examine the gate to the north. It won't open, so
start heading back south, and it'll magically open for you, allowing you
entrance. Start to go up the stairs for a quick scene, then continue north to a
fork. The path to the east is locked, so use the Save Point if you want, then
go down the western stairs, moving south and opening the chest to your west for
a [_TENT_].

Ignore the door to the west, as we can't go through it yet, and continue south
and east for another quick scene. Continue east and down the stairs here to be
back on the ground floor, but before descending the stairs to the next area,
check below the stairs to your bottom-left for a [_POCKET WATCH_]. Once you
have it, go down the stairs.

Here in the basement, you'll see a skeleton that you can examine, as well as
eight coffins, plus one to the southwest that is already open. Examine the open
one for a scene. Before going back down, go up and past the statue here,
scaling the wall as you go northeast, to a small area; search here for a chest
containing a [_LOTTERY TICKET_], then go back to the eight coffins. If you
examine the skeleton, he'll tell you:

  "Raise your voice in prayer! Pray for new writing to be turned into old!
   So long as the 8 flames remain unlit, the door to the throne will not open!
   Offer up thy prayers!"

Even though the skeleton really doesn't spell it out for you, you must pray at
each of the coffins in a certain order (which happens to be in alphabetical
order) to unlock the next door, so refer to the art below to open them:

After successfully solving the puzzle, you'll hear the sound of a door being
unlocked. Make your way back upstairs and to the Save Point. At the fork here,
take the eastern path (now that the door here is unlocked) and enter. Watch a
short bit of dialogue, then try to leave. Watch the events unfold here, and
once they're finished, Keith Valentine will join your party!

  NOTE     Keith comes equipped with the [_ANTIQUE RAPIER_], a
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   [_CHAINMAIL VEST_], and a [_POCKET WATCH_] equipped by default.

Unless you'd like to fight some more and get used to Keith's Ring, leave the
Blue Castle. Save on the World Map, then enter Bistritz once again.

  NOTE     It's strongly recommended that your entire party is at least level
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   23 before taking on the next sub-boss. The Garms outside of the
           Blue Castle are your best source of EXP AND Cash right now.

Make your way to Nina and Michelle's house in the southeastern corner. After
Nina tells you the whole story and you regain control, leave the house and head
west back to the first area. If you have the extra money, upgrade Keith's
weapon to the Royal Estoc and make sure he's properly equipped, then SAVE at
the Save Point. When you're ready, examine the lower-right door to the Mayor's
house in the upper corner. Break in?

Choose 2 when you're ready, and you'll eventually have to take on a sub-boss.

     / * SUB-BOSS * \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Tindalos              |  2000 HP  | Class: Fire  | [_] Iron Clogs           |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|                                                                             |
|  Watch out for his Deathtouch attack; it takes away 75% of your HP, which   |
|  most of the time is a MAJOR inconvenience. He can also use Fire breath,    |
|  which will hit for a decent amount of damage. Make sure to keep an eye on  |
|  his physical attacks as well, as they'll quickly whittle down your HP,     |
|  hitting for over 100 to a 150 HP per string of attacks.                    |
|                                                                             |
|  Have Alice be the primary healer, using Cure every round. If it's not      |
|  needed, have her use Blessed Light instead. Zhuzhen should be using Life   |
|  Sucker every round (or if you were able to level him up to 23, use Corpse  |
|  Arm instead), stopping only to help Alice heal when needed. Keith should   |
|  be using Drain Touch if he needs HP, or Bat Dance if he doesn't.           |
|                                                                             |
|  If you were able to get used to Keith's Ring enough to where you're        |
|  comfortable with him having the Mind's Eye equipped, I recommend that      |
|  over his Rituals, but still have him use Drain Touch when he needs         |
|  healed.                                                                    |
|                                                                             |
|  You'll most likely need to replenish MP and SP throughout the battle, as   |
|  it will take a while, but be patient and stay healed.                      |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   08000 EXP   / \   12000 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

Nothing strange about the ring here. Make sure to win the Oracle Earrings
before continuing on; it increases your max MP 20%! If you don't win it, reload
your last save and try again. Remember, you need to win something from each
member at least once!

Head over to the place where you fought Kevin for a scene. Once it's over,
check the chest to your left for a [_FLASH BADGE_], then examine the upper
right corner of the room to find a [_SEAL OF STRENGTH_] on the floor above a
cart. Once you're done there, do any shopping and preparation that you want,
then leave Bistritz and head to the Blue Castle once again.

Make your way inside the castle like you did before. When you reach the fork
with the Save Point, head west, then approach the door to the west that was
previously locked. Keith will unlock it for you, and you'll be able to continue
on. As soon as you enter the stairwell, open a hidden chest to your left for a
[_SEAL OF SPEED_], then start climbing the stairs.

Go up the first set here to the next area, then up another to the next, where
you can go inside a room to your left. In this room, open the chest in the cell
on the left for a [_PURE ROOT_], then go back out and continue climbing the
stairs.

Head up five (or six, depending on where you started counting) more screens to
find another room. Check on the floor in the cell on the left for a
[_LOTTERY TICKET_], and open the chest in the cell on the right for some
[_HEADGEAR_]. Make your way back out.

Go up another five or six screens to another room. Check on the floor in the
cell on the left for a [_TENT_], and check on the floor in the cell on the
right for a [_SEAL OF FORCE_]. Make your way back out, then continue climbing
the stairs. Keep on going, and you'll eventually reach the top of the tower.
Use the Save Point here.

  NOTE     The next boss can use Instant Death, so make sure to equip
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Leonardo's Bears to everyone.

When you're ready, enter the door for a scene. As much as you don't want to,
you have to fight our long-lost friend.

      .————————————.
     / *** BOSS *** \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Yuri                  |  1400 HP  | Class: Dark  |                          |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|        .———————————————————.———————————————————.———————————————————.        |
|        |                   |                   |     Keith [23]    |        |
|        |     Alice [23]    |    Zhuzhen [24]   |                   |        |
|        |===================|===================|===================|        |
|        | Tome of the Sun   | Hermit's Staff    | Royal Estoc       |        |
|        | Silk Bolero       | Chainmail Vest    | Chainmail Vest    |        |
|        | Anne's Cross      | Face Guard        | Mind's Eye        |        |
|        | Face Guard        | Warlock Earrings  | Metal Belt        |        |
|        | Leonardo's Bear   | Leonardo's Bear   | Leonardo's Bear   |        |
|        '———————————————————'———————————————————'———————————————————'        |
|                                                                             |
        |  Yikes! His normal three-hit combo will do MAJOR damage to anyone it hits,  |
|  so heal the survivor immediately. Yuri has quite a bit of HP, and hits     |
|  harder than anyone else thus far, so healing will be your immediate        |
|  priority.                                                                  |
|                                                                             |
|  After just about 400 HP worth of damage, Yuri will fuse into the Death     |
|  Emperor, starting to use Dark Messenger. As long as you have Leonardo's    |
|  Bears equipped, you won't die instantly, but you'll still be hit pretty    |
|  hard. Again, to reiterate: healing will be your immediate priority. Have   |
|  two people healing, if needed.                                             |
|                                                                             |
|  For the first round, have Alice cast Holy Edge on Keith to add a Light     |
|  class to his attack, then devote Alice to healing. There most likely       |
|  won't be a round where she can attack, but if you can, then use Blessed    |
|  Light. Zhuzhen should be using Corpse Arm every round, and Keith should    |
|  be attacking normally every round, with his weapon laced with Holy Edge.   |
|  Whoever is doing the least amount of damage needs to be helping Alice      |
|  heal if it's needed.                                                       |
|                                                                             |
|  Like the last few battles, it'll probably take long enough that you'll     |
|  need to replenish your MP and SP as well. Again, have whoever is doing     |
|  the least amount of damage take care of this.                              |
|                                                                             |
'—————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————'

After the battle, you'll have control of Alice in the Graveyard. Just head left
to talk to the Masks. Once they're done, go through the gate to the north and
watch the events unfold there. You'll then have to face Fox Face one last time,
as Yuri.

      .————————————.
     / * SUB-BOSS * \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Fox Face              |   555 HP  | Class: Dark  | [_] Brass Knuckles       |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|                                                                             |
|  He won't fuse into the Death Emperor this time, but he'll still use his    |
|  !!! attack. When he does, IMMEDIATELY use a Thera Seed, and DON'T even     |
|  try to hit the 'Perfect!!' mark; just get Yuri away from 1 HP, and you'll  |
|  be fine.                                                                   |
|                                                                             |
|  Fuse into either the Raging Tiger or Inferno (with Fighting Spirit) and    |
|  just start wailing away on him with physical attacks. Just keep trading    |
|  blows, using Thera Seeds to heal whenever your HP starts to get low, and   |
|  ESPECIALLY after the !!! attack.                                           |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   13000 EXP   / \   12500 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

After the battle, watch the very long sequence of events. Eventually, you'll be
able to choose your party. I'll go with Yuri, Alice, and Keith for the time
being. Before you know it, you'll be back in the forest at the entrance to the
Blue Castle.

HOWEVER... if you paid attention, you saw something glowing behind Yuri as they
left the tower, so let's go get it. Make your way back into the Castle, through
the western door, and to the very tip top of the tower into the room where you
fought Yuri. Examine the floor on the left side of the room to find the
[_DARK GRAVESTONE_], which will allow you to fight and fuse into Yuri's level 3
Dark Fusion when you have enough Soul Energy! Score!

After you have that, make your way back to the exit and to the World Map. Your
next stop will be Prague.

  NOTE     Even though you didn't see it, you accumulated Soul Energy while
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Yuri was out of your party, so there's a chance that he has one or
           more new level 2 Fusions that you'll be able to fight and try out.

  NOTE     If you don't have your level 2 Earth or Light Fusions yet, then I
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   recommend heading back inside and fighting until you get them.

Watch the events in London as you enter Rouen, then you'll regain control.
Examine the ground just above the box to your left to find a
[_LOTTERY TICKET_]. Once you have it, enter the Inn at the top of the screen.
Watch another scene in here, then you'll regain control in the Graveyard. Head
to the left and talk to the Masks.

  NOTE     To sum up everything that the Masks have said this time: The
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Talisman Yuri holds will show the level of Malice that has
           accumulated in ALICE's soul, meaning that every time SHE
           participates in a battle, the Malice Meter will increase. To get rid
           of the Malice, Yuri must return to the Graveyard and fight an
           incarnate of the Malice (Gusts, this time around) to keep from
           having to face one of the Four Masks. Each enemy you defeat with
           Alice in the party will increase the Malice Meter, so make sure that
           your Malice level does NOT reach the red. If it does, IMMEDIATELY go
           to the Graveyard and fight your Malice so that you don't fight any
           of the Masks. Right now, you WILL die if you try to fight them, so
           if you run into them, press the R1 button and choose to Run Away.

  NOTE     You can fight Gust Ein, Gust Zwei, Gust Drei, and Gust Vier by
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   returning to the Graveyard and fighting them when your Malice level
           is at a certain color:

           - Gust Ein: Between Blue and Turquoise.
           - Gust Zwei: Between Turquoise and Green.
           - Gust Drei: Between Green and Yellow.
           - Gust Vier: Between Yellow and Red.
           - After each battle, you'll receive an item based on your Malice!

     .———————————.————————————————————.  .———————————.————————————————————.
     |  Malice   |  Prize             |——|  Malice   |  Prize             |
     |===========|====================|/\|===========|====================|
     |  01 - 03  |  Thera Leaf        |\/|  57 - 59  |  Pure Leaf         |
     |       04  |  Seal of Wisdom    |/\|       60  |  Seal of Speed     |
     |  05 - 06  |  Mana Leaf         |\/|  61 - 62  |  Thera Leaf        |

  NOTE     Again, the prize you win depends on the level of Malice you have
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   accumulated, with 100 being the max value. Sadly you can't use this
           knowledge to get the special prizes again and again, as they are
           replaced with a Thera Leaf the second time you clear the Malice at
           the same value.

After they're done blabbering, leave the Graveyard to be back in the Inn. Leave
the room you're in and go to the next one to the left to find Alice has left.
Return to your room and Keith will step forward, allowing you to check the
dresser behind him for a [_TEAOFTHEHOLYONE_].

Make your way downstairs and talk to the Silent Peddler to find out that he has
a shop! Feel free to upgrade your party's weapons and equipment, then leave the
Inn and head north into the alley to find her. Watch the scene here, then
you'll have to battle a set of Bifronzes. After taking them out, you'll see
another set of scenes, and you'll regain control inside of the Inn, having to
choose a party.

  NOTE     Margarete comes re-equipped with a [_ZERUEL_] and a [_JASPER CAPE_]
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   by default.

  NOTE     If for some reason you don't have them, make sure to buy three of
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   either the Shell Bracelets or Cosmic Bracelets to defend against
           Poison for the next boss battle.

For a party, I recommend (now, and most of every other time) Yuri, Alice, and
Margarete, as Margarete gives a decent balance between physical fighting and
special skills, whereas Alice will almost always be a designated healer. If you
change your mind after choosing your party, talk to Meiyuan on the first floor
and he can change it up. When you're ready, head outside.

  NOTE     You can now encounter random battles in the streets with the
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Bifronzes, as well as some new enemies, the Camazotz, for a limited
           time. I strongly recommend taking the time to level up your Dark and
           Wind classes to level 2, if you haven't reached them already. It
           won't take very long.

  NOTE     If you didn't get your level 2 Light Fusion earlier, or if you still
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   just don't have it, then I STRONGLY recommend going back to the
           Blue Castle and fighting the Hollows until you do. It will be
           EXTREMELY useful in this next boss battle, which is pretty
           difficult.

Make your way back to the northern alley. As you enter, check the ground by the
barrels for a [_HUGE JUG_], then keep going to the next area. Here, check the
two barrels in the upper-right corner to find another [_LOTTERY TICKET_].
Examine the back door here, which is stuck. To gain entrance, you must complete
a Spin Ring 3, meaning you have to hit _NINE_ areas before you can gain
entrance. Luckily, the areas are pretty wide, so you should have no problem.

Once you're inside, make your way to the front of the church. Watch the series
of events unfold in here, then you'll have to take on Olga yet again.

      .————————————.
     / * SUB-BOSS * \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Olga                  |  3300 HP  | Class: Dark  | [_] Small Jug            |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|        .———————————————————.———————————————————.———————————————————.        |
|        |     Yuri [27]     |                   |   Margarete [26]  |        |
|        |                   |     Alice [26]    |                   |        |
|        |===================|===================|===================|        |
|        | Brass Knuckles    | Ever-Bible        | Zeruel            |        |
|        | RedLeatherJacket  | Jasper Cape       | Jasper Cape       |        |
|        | Mind's Eye        | Anne's Cross      | Charming Pareo    |        |
|        | Loin Guard        | Brsrkr Earrings   | Weird Bottle      |        |
|        | Shell Bracelet    | Shell Bracelet    | Shell Bracelet    |        |
|        |                   |                   |                   |        |
|        | Baldo             |                   |                   |        |
|        | Charon            |                   |                   |        |
|        | Inferno           |                   |                   |        |
|        '———————————————————'———————————————————'———————————————————'        |
|                                                                             |
|  Olga's Black Fog attack will do MAJOR damage to your party, as well as     |
|  Poison each one of them, so it's a good idea to come in with Shell or      |
|  Cosmic Bracelets equipped. Her Nova attack will do decent damage to a      |
|  single ally, her Icy Breath attack will hit your whole party for decent    |
|  damage, and her physical attack just does pathetic damage to a single      |
|  ally. Watch out if she uses Mind Assault to steal your MP, as you'll want  |
|  to recover it immediately if she takes too much.                           |
|                                                                             |
|  Yuri and Alice are obvious choices for this battle, and you could pretty   |
|  much pick whomever your favorite is, as they'll all do roughly the same    |
|  amount of damage. I recommend Margarete just because I had her at a        |
|  higher level than Keith and Zhuzhen, therefore having more STR and HP.     |
|  That, and I find Margarete's Ring easier to hit than Keith's. Zhuzhen      |
|  just sucks up a lot of MP and takes extra turns to replenish it. Okay,     |
|  okay, I really like her too, if that matters any.                          |
|                                                                             |
|  Fuse Yuri into Baldo (if you didn't get his level 2 Light Fusion, then     |
|  fuse into the Heaven's Fiend, as you'll need the healing) and start        |
|  physically attacking; with the Mind's Eye equipped, he'll be doing major   |
|  damage. If you didn't put the Mind's Eye on him, then go with the Nova     |
|  spell instead.                                                             |
|                                                                             |
|  Have Alice cast Holy Edge on Yuri her first round so he can keep piling    |
|  the damage up, then have her cast it on Margarete her second turn so she   |
|  can start adding in to the damage. Margarete should also be attacking      |
|  normally. If for some reason Alice doesn't need to heal, have her cast     |
|  Blessed Light on Olga.                                                     |
|                                                                             |
|  If a single ally just needs healed, have Alice do it. If two people need   |
|  it, have Alice and Margarete do it. If all three need it, then have Yuri   |
|  do it, as Olga doesn't mess around, and can easily kill your entire party  |
|  in three turns. I hate taking turns away from Yuri because he just does    |
|  so much damage, but when everyone needs healed, he's the only one that     |
|  can do anything about it efficiently.                                      |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   16000 EXP   / \   14500 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

After the battle, you'll learn that your next destination is London, and you'll
regain control outside. Head back into the church and check the altar for a
[_SEAL OF THE SOUL_], then go through the door on the right. Enter the first
door here to be in a confession booth, where you'll find a chest containing a
[_JASPER CAPE_].

Head back outside, then SAVE at the Inn. Go back out and re-enter the alleyway,
where you'll find Hooked-nose Robin, or as we come to find out, Lottery Member
No. 06!

Nothing strange about the ring here. Make sure to win the Accelerator here
before continuing on; it doubles your Pedometer steps with each step you take!
Just remember, that the person wearing the Pedometer must be wearing the
Accelerator at the same time, it won't work if they're on separate party
members. If you don't win it, reload your last save and try again. Remember,
you need to win something from each member at least once!

That's it for Rouen, so make your way back out to the World Map. Our next stop
is London, specifically, Old Castle Street. Make sure to SAVE before entering!

When you gain control, talk to the one of the first guys you see, Penniless
Mike, the one in the purple suit. He'll ask you if you want a rare card.

————————————————————————————————
   [1] I want it, I admit it!
   [2] I'm no card freak.
————————————————————————————————

If you have _7,000 CASH_ on you (yeah, it's pricey), then choose 1 to obtain
the [_SUN CARD_]. Just to the right of Penniless Mike is a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]
on the ground, so be sure to pick it up. Next, talk to the bum at the top of
the screen, Drunken Orro. He's your next Lottery Member!

While the speed of the indicator isn't anything unusual, all of the areas are
TINY! Equip the Pocket Watch before playing, and they'll be easier to hit. Make
sure to win the Priest Earrings here before continuing on; they decrease MP
consumption by 20%! If you don't win them, reload your last save and try again.
Remember, you need to win something from each member at least once!

Head north to the next area for a scene. Afterward, you'll realize that all
your money is gone, so now you've gotta get it back. First, go to your upper
left to be beside a house; now that you're past the gate, go up alongside the
house, behind the wall here. Look around on the ground, and you should find an
[_OAK SLINGSHOT_]. Go into the bar on the lower-left of the screen, where
you'll learn more about the London Rats, as well as get to name your final
party member, Halley.

  NOTE     There's a nice little easter egg for Koudelka up on the back wall of
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   the bar; it's a portrait of Koudelka along with the word art from
           the game. Neat-o!

When you regain control, talk to the Silent Peddler on the left if you wish,
then make your way behind the counter of the bar, as there is a
[_MANA EXTRACT_] on the floor. Once you have it, leave the bar, then go back to
the first area of Old Castle Street. Go into the Inn at the bottom of the
screen for some events.

Leave the Inn and head north back to the next area. Make your way to the right
side of the area, then head north when you see an abandoned house. In this
small area, follow along the very edge of the street as you go left, and you
should find a [_THERA EXTRACT_] near the broken wall. Afterward, go to the
upper-left and examine the door on the ground; you'll have to do a Push Ring to
lift it up and descend the ladder into the London Rats' hideout.

On this platform, take a few steps to the left and examine the floor here to
find a set of [_DEMON EARRINGS_], then go down the small ramp, walking to the
far right side of the room to find a [_LOTTERY TICKET_] lying on the floor. Go
up the little set of wooden stairs to your left to make your way to a Save
Point, then continue along and up the ladder in the upper-right corner.

Check below the crate beside where you entered to find a [_SOUL BENEDICTION_],
then continue up the stairs. You'll see more scenes up here, where you'll get
your money back (minus a little bit that they already spent), as well as
receive a [_CRUCIFIX_]. You'll also be introduced to Halley, who will now
accompany you. Check the left side of the room to find a [_WARNING DEVICE_],
then check the area to the left of the fireplace on the right side of the room
for a [_TALISMANOFPURITY_].

Leave the hideout and make your way to the last house on the right side of
town, which is the residence of Knowledgeable Carl. After a rather short
discussion in here, check the floor by the bench on your left for a [_SEAL OF
FORCE_], the bookshelf to the upper-left for a [_LOTTERY TICKET_], and the
smaller bookshelf to the upper-left for a [_KIRIN SCALE_].

That's it for Old Castle Street for just a moment. Head out to the World Map,
then go to the Orphanage that appears.


   Orphanage
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
After the quick scene, enter the mansion to meet a man named Jack. After
another short discussion, you'll be escorted out. Leave the Orphanage, and
after another quick scene, you'll be back at the Inn on Old Castle Street.


   Old Castle Street
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Watch the events here, then go back out to the streets. Make your way back to
the London Rats' hideout, where you'll need to pick out a new party that
includes both Yuri and Halley, who has now officially joined your party. I
recommend Alice as a dedicated healer.

  NOTE     Halley comes equipped with a [_SLINGSHOT_] and a
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   [_REDLEATHERJACKET_] by default. Make sure to equip him with the
           Oak Slingshot you found earlier.

If you need to upgrade your equipment, stop in at the bar and talk to the
Silent Peddler to do so. When you're ready, leave Old Castle Street and make
your way to the Orphanage once again.

  NOTE     If for some reason you really want one of the other three in your
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   party in place of Alice, you can go back to the Inn and talk to
           Meiyuan to do so.

Enter the Orphanage, then SAVE your game on the right. When you're ready, try
to go through the western door to trigger a scene and a sub-boss battle.

      .————————————.
     / * SUB-BOSS * \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Night Stalker         |  2500 HP  | Class: Wind  | [_] Kid's Room Key       |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|                                                                             |
|  There's not much to worry about with this guy; other than boosting         |
|  himself up, his physical attacks do a decent amount of damage, but that's  |
|  it. Have Alice whoever is attacked.                                        |
|                                                                             |
|  Have Yuri fuse into Ifrit, using Ignition to boost his attack power, then  |
|  start wailing on the Night Stalker with physical attacks. Have Halley      |
|  constantly use his Strong Earth attack, which should do pretty decent      |
|  damage to the wind-based enemy. Have Alice keep everyone healed, using     |

|                                                                             |

After taking him out, open the door to the left for a scene, where you'll
receive the [_GUESTROOM KEY_]. Check near the bed in the lower-left corner to
find a [_SEAL OF LUCK_], then check behind the bed on the left in the middle
for a [_PURE EXTRACT_]. Finally, check between the two beds at the top of the
screen for a [_MONKEY PAW_]. Once you have everything, go back out into the
hallway.

Head up the stairs, then go right and down to find an [_EYE OF OUROBOROS_]. Now
make your way to the left side of the room, then down to find a
[_ZODIAC BRACELET_]. Next, head into the room against the upper wall, on the
left side. Examine the books on the table in here to do a Normal Ring that
spins REALLY fast, which will allow you to see the following date:
5, March, 75, so remember "5375" for later. Check the floor in front of the
fireplace for a [_LOTTERY TICKET_], then feel free to read the diary on the
desk at the bottom of the screen if you like. Leave the room.

Go over to the door on the right upstairs, and it'll ask for a password, so
enter "5375" from the picture's date to unlock the door. Check in front of the
fireplace in this room to find some [_MONK EARRINGS_], then check the desk
above the fireplace for another Normal Ring. After completing it, read the
master's diary to find out what's really been going on around here, then
examine the painting to the right of the desk, showing it was done on the
following date: 3 July, 54, so remember "3754" for the next password. Leave
this room, then SAVE YOUR GAME.

  NOTE     The next boss uses Paralysis, and the one after that uses
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Petrification, so make sure each party member is wearing either a
           Zodiac Bracelet or a Crucifix to prevent both.

When you're ready, examine the northern door in the center and input "3754",
then go inside. Watch the events unfold, and you'll have to take on Jack
himself.

      .————————————.
     / * SUB-BOSS * \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Jack                  |  2500 HP  | Class: Water | [_] Seal of Speed        |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|                                                                             |
|  Jack will mainly just use his Paralysis attack against you, though you     |
|  should be guarded by a Zodiac Bracelet or a Crucifix. He will also use     |
|  pretty strong physical attacks, and his Slash attack, which will do MAJOR  |
|  damage to one party member, so make sure to stay healed. He will use       |
|  Thera Seeds when his HP starts to drop.                                    |
|                                                                             |
|  When fighting, keep in mind that you have a harder boss battle right       |
|  after this, with no chance to heal.                                        |
|                                                                             |
|  Have Yuri fuse into Ifrit and use his Ignition to boost his attack, then   |
|  have him attack as normal. Have Halley cast Strong Earth continuously      |
|  (not Aqua Blade, since Jack is water based) for the whole battle, unless   |
|  he's learned Air Shot by now, then by all means, use that. Alice should    |
|  be healing as needed, using Blessed Light when no healing is needed.       |
|                                                                             |
|  If you're comfortable at the end, take a turn or two to make sure          |
|  everyone is healed to the max and ready for the next battle.               |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   17000 EXP   / \   15000 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

Without getting a chance to breathe, you'll be thrown into an even harder boss
battle.

      .————————————.
     / *** BOSS *** \

Make your way all the way downstairs, saving if you wish. Talk to little Joshua
down here, who will ask Halley if he can have his slingshot.

There's one more item to be had at the Orphanage, so leave Old Castle Street
and go back to the Orphanage one last time. Go into the center room where you
fought Jack and check behind the wire grating on the right; you'll find the
[_DRAZE_], a better gun for Margarete.

That's it for events within the London city limits for now, so head back out to
the Britain section of the World Map, then make your way to the Calios Mental
Hospital.

   [1] Okay, we'll leave.

Choose 2 to have to take on a set of Specters. Watch the following scenes, then
check the small shack where the guards were to find a chest containing a
[_LAUREL SLINGSHOT_] for Halley. Go just to the right of that area behind the
pillar on the right to find another chest, this one containing a
[_DEMONWARDNCKLACE_]. Make your way inside, and take out another set of
Specters that come at you.

After they're finished, go to the top of the screen and examine the sparkling
object in the northwest corner to find a [_BRONZE COIN_]. Go east to the next
area, taking on another set of Specters. Keep going right, opening the chest at
the right side of the room for a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. Go down into the next
room, note the torture chair, and continue south to what appears to be the last
room.

Move west to take on another set of two Specters, taking them out as well. Move
to the head of the body and examine it for the [_HEART KEY_], then examine the
sparkling object above the body, beside the table for the [_SILVER COIN_].
There's nowhere else to go right now, so let's go back to the first area inside
the hospital to unlock some doors.

The room in the bottom-right corner of the area will now open with the Heart
Key, so head inside and open the two chests, a [_KEY TO SUCCESS_], and a
[_CLUB KEY_]. Leave this room and head into the next room, opening the chest in
here for a rare and welcome [_FRUIT OF YGGDRASIL_]. Leave this room and go
north into the next hallway.

Enter the first door on the top-left, getting the [_DIAMOND KEY_] out of the
chest, then head east two doors to the next room. Check the sparkling object on
the ground near the bench on the upper wall for the [_GOLD COIN_], then exit
and enter the last room on the right, where you'll find another sparkling
object in roughly the same area as the last, the [_PLATINUM COIN_].

Make your way back to the innermost room that you've reached so far, the one
with the Save Point. Drop the Bronze Coin in the upper-right vase, the Platinum
Coin in the lower-right vase, the Gold Coin in the lower-left, and the Silver
Coin in the upper-left, allowing a new passage to open. SAVE YOUR GAME.

  NOTE     The next boss uses Silence, and the one after that uses Poison, so
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   make sure to equip Cosmic Bracelets and/or your Crucifix.

When you're ready, go down the staircase to the next area and examine the huge
door for a scene and a sub-boss battle.

After the battle, Halley will temporarily leave your party. Make your way back
upstairs, then head to the hallway just past the torture chair. You can now
finally enter the second door from the left, so go inside, then examine the
chest for the [_DUNGEON KEY_]. Watch a short scene with Halley, then when you
regain control, check the chest once again for the [_FIRE GRAVESTONE_]. Feel
free to use the bed in here as an Inn to recover your HP and MP.

  NOTE     If you're close to level 35 for Alice, then I strongly recommend
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   fighting a bit more to reach 35 so she can learn the Arc spell.
           It'll greatly help out in the next boss battle.

When you're ready, head back to the room with the Save Point and SAVE, then go
back downstairs, unlock the door, and take on Olga for the last time!

Here in the London Rats' hideout, make your way downstairs and use the Save
Point. Make note of a new path to your left; it leads to a Pit Fight hosted by
Sharon! If you talk to her at all, you'll have to battle a random set of
enemies alone with Yuri. Her power isn't very stable yet, so you won't be able
to engage in the actual Pit Fight like you did with Mr. Zhen, but you will in
time.

Go back into the previous room and talk to Joshua to receive the
[_OATH GRAIL_]; if you're going for the good ending, then it's critical that
you get this item. Leave the hideout, then make your way toward the entrance of
the city for an event with Halley, which will eventually lead to you
controlling Alice. Choose to enter Rouen.

Push Ring to open the door, then go to the altar room for a quick scene. Next,
go to the confessionals on the right side. Go into the back confessional here

done, you'll finally know the story between Roger Bacon and Albert Simon, and
you'll see a picture of Father Hans Doyle and Cardinal Albert Simon... Leave
the confessional for another event, then you'll regain control in London.

After the quick scene, choose your party. Put Halley in it to start with so we
can obtain a better weapon for him. Make your way downstairs and talk to
Joshua, where you'll receive the [_IMPROVED SLINGSHOT_].

Now you can make your way to the Inn and talk to Meiyuan to choose the party
you want for the upcoming events. I'll be taking Yuri, Alice, and Margarete.

Out on the World Map, go out to the Britain Map to see a new destination open
up: the Nemeton Monastery.

Now... There are a few quick things to do before we go to the next dungeon. If
you wish to just continue the story, go to W-2-12 - Nemeton Monastery (1).

At this point in the game, we can now obtain all but one Gravestone, which we
will obtain just moments after beginning the next story section.

Here's how to find the remaining Gravestones...


   Dark Gravestone   (Blue Castle)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
You should've already picked this up. It was at the top of the tower in the
Blue Castle where you fought Yuri.


   Fire Gravestone   (Calios Mental Hospital)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
You should've already picked this up. It was in the chest that you found the
Dungeon Key in the Calios Mental Hospital. You had to examine it a second time
to pick it up.


  Light Gravestone   (Nemeton Monastery)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
You will be able to pick this up in the first house you see to the left in the
Nemeton Monastery once you start W-2-12 - Nemeton Monastery (1). It'll be
inside the house, past the vending machine.


    Air Gravestone   (Prague)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Make your way to Prague and enter the bar. Talk to the Owner and he'll say that
Darcie's been in the bathroom for a while, so go into the men's room and
examine the second stall. Watch the events here, and as long as you have some
Tissues in your inventory, Yuri will give them to him to help him out. Attempt
to leave the bar, and you'll receive the [_AIR GRAVESTONE_] as a thank you from
him. Just make sure to wash it off, as well as your hands...

  NOTE     If you don't want to waste a Lottery Ticket to get the Tissues, you
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   can get some later on by winning the Pit Fight with Margarete (once
           it becomes available), or you can win them from the Buggy enemies in
           the Cave Temple.


  Earth Gravestone   (Bistritz)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Visit Bistritz and go to the right side of the village. Examine the sparkling
sprout outside of the shop, then go inside and talk to Nina to learn more about
it. Go back outside and examine it once again.

MAKE SURE TO CHOOSE 1! Once you do, leave Bistritz, then come back. Continue to
choose 1 and leave the village, repeating the process until Nina is waiting for
you beside the plant. Once she is, talk to her to receive the
[_EARTH GRAVESTONE_].


  Water Gravestone   (Rouen)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Take a trip to Rouen and go into the Inn and go up the stairs for a quick
scene. Go through the door on the right and talk to both Indignant Mary and
Upset John, then make your way to the church and enter the confessional in the
back. Upset John will come in and ask you what you think he should do.

_________________________________________________________
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
          [1] Get her a diamond, as promised.

   ———>   [2] It's about love, not the ring.      <———
          ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
          [3] Maybe it'd be better to split up.
_________________________________________________________
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Make sure to choose 2, otherwise you'll be forced to pay for the Water
Gravestone, 3,000 Cash if you choose 1, and 10,000 Cash if you choose 3.

In any case, once you can leave the church, head back to the Inn and into the
room, where you'll find John and Mary. John will thank you for your words, and
he'll give you the [_WATER GRAVESTONE_] as a thank you for saving his marriage.
(If you chose 1, you'll have to pay 3,000 Cash.)

  NOTE     Wild John will be on the bottom-right of the first area if you chose
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   3 instead, and you can buy the Gravestone there.

  NOTE     If you don't do this event now, you may not be able to later
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   depending on how far you progress in the story. I strongly recommend
            doing it now, as you can miss out on a great accessory, as well as
           Margarete's best weapon, if you don't.





=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=

That's it for Gravestones, so make your way to the Nemeton Monastery!

After the dialogue, enter the pretty slick-looking house on the left. Make your
way down the stairs, and just before reaching the center, take the stairs off
to your left and past the vending machine here to the end, where you'll find
the final gravestone, the [_LIGHT GRAVESTONE_].

There's nothing else to do in here, so leave the house, then make your way
north up the hill. Examine the tombstone to your northwest to find the grave of
James O'Flaherty, then open the chest just to the right of it for a
[_MANT.OFNOBILITY_] for Keith. Go through the doorway here to be within the
walls of the Monastery for an event.

When you regain control, go east, following the path at the top of the screen
as it goes east, then down to a dead-end where you'll find a
[_TALISMANOFPOWER_]. Once you have it, head back to Roger's house, where you'll
have to watch an extremely long series of events.

When you regain control once again, examine the vending machine to the north
that we passed earlier. Look at the chart below to see who to upgrade; there
are quite a few nice items in the next dungeon that are better than what we can
buy here:

.———————————————.—————————.—————————.
|   Character   | Upgrade | Upgrade |
|   Name        | Weapon? |  Armor? |
|———————————————|—————————|—————————|
|   Yuri        |    N    |    Y    |
|   Alice       |    N    |    Y    |
|   Zhuzhen     |    Y    |    N    |
|   Margarete   |    N    |    Y    |
|   Keith       |    Y    |    N    |
|   Halley      |    Y    |    N    |
'———————————————'—————————'—————————'

In other words, buy only Armor for Yuri, Alice, and Margarete, and buy only
weapons for Zhuzhen, Keith, and Halley, if needed.

  NOTE     Make sure to have 3 Will Powers and 3 Leonardo's Bears (optional)
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   for the next boss battle, as he can use both SP Lowering and
           Instant Death.

Feel free to stock up on healing items. When you're ready, leave Roger's house
and return to the Monastery Ruins at the top of the hill to have Roger unlock
the path to the underground ruins.

  NOTE     With the newer weapons, the hit area is decreased once again. We'll
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   be finding another Mind's Eye inside (which I think works great with
           Margarete, since she has one of the easiest rings), so you may want
           to invest the Cash with Meiyuan to increase both Yuri's and
           Margarete's Hit Areas to help, ONCE you find their new weapons in
           the next area. Don't worry, they're not too far in.

When you regain control, go underground and feel free to use the Save Point,
then go west for a scene. Talk to Roger to have him recover your HP and MP,
then head west into the ruins.

  NOTE     If you want to just grab Yuri's and Margarete's weapons really quick
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   to upgrade them, Yuri's is one screen to the right and up (slightly
           hidden), and Margarete's is two screens to the left (slightly
           hidden).

Take a few steps down, then search to the right to find a [_LOTTERY TICKET_].
Down the next set of steps is a fork; make your way west to the next area, then
west once again to another. There's a slightly hidden chest directly to your
west; open it for a [_MAUSER PROTOTYPE_] for Margarete. At the fork here, take
the southeastern path to the next area, following it to another area with a
dead-end. Close the chest here to open a different one nearby, then make your
way back to the entrance of the ruins.

Back at the entrance, take the eastern path to the next area, where you'll be
at another fork. Continue east down the stairs to a dead-end with two chests.
Open the northern one to drop the guard from the blue orb, then examine the orb
to light up a pillar in another room.

Head back to the last screen, then head north, opening the semi-hidden chest to
your west to find a [_SILVER WOLF FANG_] for Yuri. Continue north to find a
chest that's unguarded; it contains the [_MIND'S EYE_], which I recommend
equipping on Margarete, but you can put it on whomever you like, if you're
comfortable with their ring.

Make your way west back to the entrance, then go back west to the fork where
you found the Mauser Prototype, taking the western path this time to the next
area. At the fork here, examine the red orb to the north to change the color of
the pillar in the other room, as well as remove the guard from the chest. Open
it for a [_HOLYBOOK-MARTYRS_] for Alice, then take the southwestern path at the
fork down the stairs to the next area.

Ignore the path to the east that leads to the glowing red pit for now, and
continue southeast to the next area. Continue along past the now-purple flame
to the next area with a three-way fork near a yellow-guarded chest. Go
northwest up the stairs first, following the path through this area to reach
the green orb; examine it to change the pillar flame's color to white.

Make your way all the way back to the entrance of the ruins, then take the
eastern path to be at the fork near where you found both the Mind's Eye and the
Silver Wolf Fang. Head all the way north to open the chest that was guarded
before for a [_COAT OF THE SAGE_] for Zhuzhen. From here, go east to the area
where we found the blue orb, and examine it once again for the light go from
white to yellow.

If you're hurting, stop by and have Roger heal you and Save if needed, then
head back into the ruins and head west, returning to the fork with the yellow-
guarded chest. It will now be unguarded, so open it for a [_SEAL OF VITALITY_].

Now that you've opened all of the chests related to the puzzle, there's a VERY
IMPORTANT item that we must get. Go back two screens to the west to the glowing
red pit, where the [_DESTRUCTIONSTONE_] will float down into your possession.
You MUST obtain the DestructionStone to obtain either of the last two Fusions
for Yuri! If you don't, then you can't get them!!!

From the glowing red pit, make your way east two screens, then northeast and
east at the fork there to come to the end of the path. Use the Save Point, then
open the chests to the left and right of the large door here for a
[_SEAL OF STRENGTH_] and a [_PUNK JACKET_] for Halley. Save again if you like,
then examine the double doors. Ready?

———————————————————————————————
   [1] I'm not ready yet.
   [2] All right, let's go!!
———————————————————————————————

Choose 2 when you're completely prepared. Watch the events after you enter,
then climb all the stairs to find Albert, where you'll have to face him.

|  Albert's Holy Chest attack will do some decent damage, but even worse,     |
|  it'll reduce the amount of SP your entire party has by half, so making     |
|  sure that you had those Will Power Accessories equipped will help MAJORLY  |
|  in keeping the SP damage from happening. Other than that, he has a         |
|  physical attack that will do a decent amount of damage, and his            |
|  Revelation attack will also do a decent amount of damage, but to your      |
|  entire party with a chance of Instant Death. He rarely uses Revelation,    |
|  but if you have problems with the Instant Death it causes, equip some      |
|  Leonardo's Bears and try again.                                            |
|                                                                             |
|  Have Yuri fuse into Ifrit (or Forron if he has it) and cast Ignition (or   |
|  Battle Cry) to boost his attack (as well as Margarete's, if you're using   |
|  Ifrit and have the time), then have him attack normally every round.       |
|  Alice should cast Holy Edge on both Yuri and Margarete to start with,      |
|  then have her be devoted each round to casting Arc to keep everyone        |
|  healed. Margarete should have the Mind's Eye equipped and attacking        |
|  normally while being laced with Holy Edge, just like Yuri.                 |
|                                                                             |
|  Any time after dealing over 2000 damage to Albert, he will fuse into       |
|  Amon. Continue with the exact same strategy as above, minus the Holy Edge  |
|  since Amon is non-class.                                                   |
|                                                                             |
|  Amon's Atomic Dust spell will do pretty good damage to your entire party,  |
|  and he'll also hit with his physical attacks, which can cause major        |
|  damage to a single ally. You need to watch out for Demon Rays though, as   |
|  it'll either kill or nearly kill whomever it hits.                         |
|                                                                             |

    \   35000 EXP   / \   18000 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

  NOTE     At the end of the battle, you'll acquire the [_AMON_] Fusion Soul,
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   but ONLY if you got the DestructionStone in the ruins.

Watch the long series of events, then you'll regain control in Roger's house.
Complete the Spin Ring 3 to send Roger off, the watch another scene until you
regain control. Leave Roger's house and Nemeton Monastery.

There's one last thing to do story-wise before taking on a plethora of side
quests to get everything else in the game, as well as determine which ending
we'll receive. Head to Old Castle Street in London.





=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=
                           London, Old Castle Street
=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=

Make your way to the London Rats' hideout, and head to the top floor. Watch the
events up here with Koudelka and Halley, as well as with the rest of your
party. Watching this event will allow you to now complete the rest of what the
game has to offer, so make sure to watch this before trying to continue on with
the side quests!

  NOTE     Keep in mind that in addition to Meiyuan, Chris in the London Rats'
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   hideout can now switch your party members for you.

Now, we're SUPPOSED to continue with the story, but there's an unholy amount to
do, side-quest wise! If you don't care about side-quests or the good ending,
then just go to W-2-14 - Nemeton Monastery (2). Otherwise, let's get started
below!

AT THIS POINT, DO NOT TALK TO ROGER BACON AT NEMETON MONASTERY! It's best to
keep the story from progressing before we take care of the side quests.

[W-S-06] Nemeton Monastery (Book of Rituals / Codex of Lurie)
         - We can obtain two Valuables that will allow us to be able to get the
           best Fusion for Yuri, as well as unlock the Ancient Ruins.


[W-S-07] The Orphanage (Emigre Manuscript / Lottery Member #3)
         - We can get another Valuable, as well as meet with one of the final
           Lottery Members.


[W-S-08] Rouen (Silent Peddler / Margarete's Armor, Weapon, &
                Confession / Zhuzhen's Armor / Lottery Member #2)
         - We can see all that the Silent Peddler has to offer, including
           Margarete's best armor. We can also get hear best weapon, and dive
           into her thoughts as well. Lastly, we can also get Zhuzhen's best
           armor and meet with one of the final Lottery Members.


[W-S-09] Blue Castle (Keith's Weapon / Lottery Member #1)
         - We can get Keith's best weapon, as well as meet the second to last
           Lottery Member.


[W-S-10] Prague (Rare Shop / The Dollhouse / Alice's Weapon)
         - We can visit one more new shop which has some rare items, and we get
           to take on a bonus dungeon, as well as obtain Alice's best weapon.


[W-S-11] Cave Temple (Keith's Armor / Zhuzhen's Weapon)
         - We get to take on a bonus dungeon, as well as obtain Keith's best
           armor and Zhuzhen's best weapon.


[W-S-12] Ancient Ruins (Alice's Armor / Halley's Weapon)
         - We get to take on a bonus dungeon, as well as obtain Alice's best
           armor and Halley's best weapon.


[W-S-13] Yuri's Level 2 & 3 Fusions, ???? Attacks
         - We can make sure that Yuri has all of his Fusions, and if he
           doesn't, where to go to level up his Soul Energy to get them.


[W-S-14] Sharon's Pit Fight (Halley's Armor / Other Items)
         - We can fight plenty of summoned monsters, just like the Pit Fight
           before! This time, everyone can get a reward, including Halley and
           his best armor!


[W-S-15] The Good Ending (Defeating the Masks)
         - We can take out those Masks that have been provoking us the whole
           game, as well as determine the ending.

Make your way to the Nemeton Monastery and head up the hill toward James
        O'Flaherty's grave. As you approach it, you'll watch a long scene between Alice
and Yuri as Zhuzhen checks out the grave, and eventually brings you the
[_BOOK OF RITUALS_]. Examine the Book of Rituals in your Valuables menu, and
it'll unlock the Ancient Ruins on your World Map the next time you're there.

  NOTE     You can put whomever you want back into your party now.
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Make your way back into the Underground Ruins of the Nemeton Monastery, and
follow the path as it goes all the way west, then down when you can't go west
anymore and head all the way east until you can follow the path back to the
shrine where you fought Amon. If you check the ground here in the center of the
Judgment Ring near the altar, you will find the [_CODEX OF LURIE_].

That's it for here. On to the next quest!
