Make your way back to the Orphanage in London. Go into the room where you
fought Jack and Mammon, and talk to the little boy, Insolent Jean. He wonders
if you want to play with him and his friends.

——————————————————————————————
   [1] Alright, we'll play.
   [2] I'm busy.
——————————————————————————————

Choose 1 and you'll start playing. You have one minute to find all of his
friends, so quickly each of the 5 rooms here to find 4 children: the room
you're currently in with Insolent Jean, the large hallway, the top-right room,
the top-left room, and the bottom-left room. There's only one kid in each room,
and their locations will be random, so it may take two or three tries to find
them all. You must also return to Insolent Jean and talk to him before the
timer runs out to succeed.

Once you've won, you'll be able to go past him. Climb the stairs and examine
the pot, and you'll receive the [_EMIGRE MANUSCRIPT_] from Pot-lover Macken. As
with the Books of Rituals, examine the Emigre Manuscript in your Valuables
menu, and it'll unlock the Cave Temple on your World Map (the Britain Map,
specifically) the next time you're out there.

After you receive the Manuscript, go out into the hallway and SAVE. Then go
back in and talk to Pot-lover Macken once more, and you'll find out that he's a
Lottery Member!

The ring here moves REALLY fast. And in addition to that, the hit areas are
pretty small. Normally, equipping the Pocket Watch would make it run normally,
but it has no effect this time, so it'll probably take you QUITE a few tries to
get this. This guy is special for one reason: Once you win the 10 Gauge for
Margarete, he will revert back to Lottery Member No. 06.

 - The Eye of Ouroboros fully Restores MP and SP when used. You may want to get
   a few of these, as they'll come in handy in the final battles.

 - The Seal of Strength increases your strength, obviously. I don't think they
   ever really benefit your party members THAT much, so avoid getting them
   UNLESS you've already bought all you like with your Lottery Tickets and have
   extra to spend.

 - The Dice of Caesar allow some of your allies to gain 3x strength in battle,
   but can miss some or all of your party sometimes. I avoid these just because
   it's not a guaranteed boost in battle, but some others may find it useful.

 - The 10 Gauge is Margarete's best weapon; make sure to win it, but save it
   for last. You may even want to wait on getting this until you visit the
   remaining Lottery Members, depending on how many of these middle three items
    you may want.

If you don't win, reload your last save and try again. Remember, you need to
win something from each member at least once!

That's it for here. On to the next quest!

inform Keith of something she saw in the Blue Castle, which will now let you
continue with the event there, so head over to the Blue Castle.


   Blue Castle
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Head inside the castle, then go north up to the Save Point. Take the western
path, follow it around and down to the basement with the caskets. Approach the
open casket to find a Golden Bat! It's actually Keith's brother, and he'll give
him the [_DEMONSWD-TYRVING_]. You'll then have to face him as Keith (alone) to
earn it!

¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   you about the Dollhouse.

After entering Prague, make your way all the way to the north end of town and
talk to the Silent Peddler. He is now selling items, and man, are they GOOD! If
you have some extra cash built up, you may want to stock up on each of the Mana
and Pure Extracts, but not Thera Extracts; you can get those for 100 steps
apiece with the Pedometer Service. You may also want to take the opportunity to
get some Third Keys; they can make some boss battles go by WAY quicker if a
beefed-up Yuri hits all 9 areas. :-D

After shopping, make your way to the bar and talk to Runaway Ewan, who's just
below the Owner and Yuria; he'll tell you about a possessed house, and asks
that you exorcise it. By talking to him, we've now opened a new area of the
World Map: the Dollhouse. Leave Prague, then head into the Dollhouse.

  NOTE     You should probably equip the two Crucifixes you have as well, and
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   probably a combination Zodiac and Cosmic Bracelet on the third
           person. Check out the status effects of the enemies below to see

  NOTE     Alice must be in your party to be able to do anything here.
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
After the quick scene, you'll regain control as Alice. Before entering the
house, head over to the left and examine the ground below the barrels to find
the [_ORACLE EARRINGS_]. Go inside the house and use the Save Point if you
wish, then examine the grandfather clock to your left to find a [_CRANK_].

Go into the room to the upper-right of the Save Point and examine the table
just below you as you enter for a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. Go up the stairs to your
upper-left and through the doorway here to be at a fountain. Go up to the left
side of it and examine it to have to do a Push Ring. When you complete it
successfully, you'll receive the [_STOREROOM KEY_].

Head back outside of the house and examine the western door near where you
found the Oracle Earrings. With the key, you can now go through here, so do so,
then examine the generator above you to use the Crank to start it. To your
upper-right, you should see some shovels and a bucket; examine the bucket to
find a [_SILVER HAND_]. Climb down the ladder to your right, then check at the
very bottom of the screen; where you see the two bottles and the glass, you'll
find a [_SLIDE_] plate.

Make your way back into the other side of the house, then go up the stairs to
the left of the Save Point and into the room here. Examine the projector on the
table to the right to use the Slide, where you'll see that the picture
projected was taken on December 24, or 1224.

Go back downstairs and into the room to the right. Examine the dial beside the
fireplace, and you'll be able to enter a code. Enter 1224, then make your way
back to the Save Point, making sure to both Save and recover, as we're taking
on a boss next.

Go back outside, then through the storeroom, down the ladder, then down and
right to the door here. Go through it, then down the stairs to a large door
that you can now open since the water has been drained.

Okay, be honest... Did you jump when you first walked into the room to see the
doll baby riding the rocking horse? I played Resident Evil: Nemesis when I was
a bit too young, so certain things catch me off guard...

In any case, before exploring too much, open the chest at the foot of the bed
for a [_CRUCIFIX_]. You should now have THREE of them!

  NOTE     Take the time now to equip each party member with a Crucifix, or at
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   least a Zodiac or Rosewood Bracelet.

When you're ready, try to leave the room... *shudder*

Start walking west and head through the arches to be inside the temple. Make
your way northeast and through the door here, and you'll arrive inside the
maze. It's very easy to get lost in here, so follow along carefully. Each room
has three doors: north, west, and east, and they all look exactly alike. To get
all of the treasures, and to get through the maze, take the following paths
from the first room inside the maze:

 - NORTH, opening the chest here for some [_PRIEST EARRINGS_].
 - SOUTH, back to the first room.
 - WEST.
 - NORTH.
 - WEST.
 - SOUTH.
 - SOUTH.
 - WEST.
 - NORTH, opening the chest here for a [_LOTTERY TICKET_].
 - SOUTH, back to the previous room.
 - WEST.
 - NORTH.
 - WEST, to a Save Point.
 - NORTH, where you'll find Keith's best armor, the [_MANT.OFSHIVERING_].

You'll be back at the entrance after opening the chest. Examine the Emigre
Manuscript once again, which has actually changed in both description and
fragrance. By re-examining it, it will change the maze inside.

Re-enter the maze once again. The path is very similar to the previous path,
but for all paths where you needed to go west, you now need to go east.

 - NORTH, opening the chest here for a [_FIFTH KEY_].
 - SOUTH, back to the first room.
 - EAST.
 - NORTH.
 - EAST.
 - SOUTH.
 - SOUTH.
 - EAST.
 - NORTH, opening the chest here for a [_KEY TO SUCCESS_].
 - SOUTH, back to the previous room.
 - EAST.
 - NORTH.
 - EAST, to a Save Point.

Use the Save Point. Make sure you have Crucifixes equipped, then when you're
ready, head north to take on Cherubim.

   Unlocking the ???? attacks
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
To unlock the higher level Fusion's ???? attacks, Yuri must be Berserk as that
Fusion. Once he is, he'll cast it on the enemy, and will know it from then on.

The best way to do this is to equip the Small Jug so 2 SP are taken per round,
and the Monk Earrings so your SP is lower. Fight a battle, then go to the
Graveyard and fight the Malice. Fuse Yuri into the Fusion you want, then keep
Defending until Yuri goes Berserk, obliterating the Evil with your new spell.

  NOTE     You do not need to know the ???? spells to obtain the
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   SeraphicRadiance.

¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

As I mentioned before, Sharon is now hosting pit fights! Just visit the London
Rats' hideout in Old Castle Street and take western red plank to find Sharon
and Knowledgeable Carl. It doesn't cost anything to fight this time around, and
you'll have to fight 10 consecutive battles, with no chance to heal between
battles. There are 12 sets of enemies; the order is random, and you'll only
have to fight 10 of the 12 sets of enemies listed in the Enemy Formations
section above.

For items, make sure to have what you consider "enough" of the following:

 - Thera Root
 - Thera Extract (Silent Peddler) (for the Wind Shears)
 - Mana Root
 - Pure Seed
 - Third Keys (optional, for the Wind Shears)

For equipment, make sure that everyone has their best weapon and armor
available, obviously. As for accessories, CRUCIFIXES ARE A MUST HAVE! Don't
even attempt this Pit Fight without one.

For the other two accessory slots, for the fighters (Yuri / Margarete / Keith /
Halley), I recommend a combo of the Mind's Eye and Brsrkr Earrings so they can
do excellent physical damage and have extra HP. They should only need to use
their Special Attacks on a select few enemies.

For the mages (Alice / Zhuzhen), I recommend equipping the Brsrkr Earrings to
increase their HP, and Priest Earrings to reduce their MP consumption by 20%.
There's only one enemy they'll NEED to physically attack (Happy Creeper), but
the rest of them should be able to be defeated by magic.

For the characters levels, the fighters should be able to do fine around 40
with little to no problems, or even 35 if you want a bit of a challenge, but
the mages will most likely need to be around 48 for Alice (Advent) and 47 for
Zhuzhen (Flames of Fudo) to be able to make it through without issues, mainly
because that's when they learn their best spells. It CAN be done at earlier
levels, but it will be a bit harder. If you like, you can come back after
you've made some more progress in the story. Just keep in mind there's not much
story left!


   Yuri / Margarete / Keith / Halley strategy
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
With the Mind's Eye, Brsrkr Earrings, and Crucifix equipped, you should be
attacking normally every round. The only issues you should run into are the
Wind Shears. The former bosses may seem to pose a threat, but they really can't
do much except for the fact that they'll take three to four times longer to
defeat than a normal enemy. Keep your HP and SP up. For more detailed
strategies on the harder enemies, see below.


   Alice / Zhuzhen strategy
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Make sure they're in the BACK ROW, then with the Brsrkr Earrings, Priest
Earrings, and Crucifix equipped, you should be casting Advent with Alice and
Flames of Fudo with Zhuzhen every round. If you do not have these spells, then
don't even try the Pit Fight yet; it's MUCH more difficult. Make sure to stay
healed every second or third round, because you'll most likely be taking more
damage than the fighters were. Keep your HP and SP up. For more detailed
strategies on the harder enemies, see below.


There are some special notes on certain enemies:


   Dark Judge / Tindalos
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
These enemies use Deathtouch, which instantly puts your HP into the
critical zone. Make sure to heal immediately after they use it.


   Tindalos / Night Stalker / Mammon / Rausan
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
There's nothing TOO special about these guys, other than the fact that they
were former bosses, meaning that they have more HP, so it'll take longer to
defeat them. Mammon will most likely take the longest; she'll use Howling over
and over near the end, and if you're not strong enough to deal enough damage to
make up the difference, then you'll need to either level up or hope for better
luck.


   Full Armor Wind Shear / Perfect Wind Shear
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Another set of new models of Wind Shear, like the ones in Mr. Zhen's Pit Fight.
These guys are even worse, and are the reason you'll most likely need to be at
high levels to make it through this pit fight. They hit really hard, and will
almost always kill you in two turns if you're not at a high enough level,
making it almost impossible to kill them. Luckily, as long as you have a
Crucifix, you won't have to worry about status abnormalities. Make sure to heal
every other round, and if that isn't enough to keep up, shift to the back row
so you can lessen the damage. It'll take longer, but at least you can survive
that way. You MAY want to invest into some Third Keys to give yourself a chance
for when you CAN attack.


  NOTE     If you're aiming to get a full Monster Library, then make sure that
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   you find both the Full Armor and Perfect Wind Shears before moving
           on.

Once you are able to complete a set of ten fights, instead of being rewarded
with cash, you'll be rewarded differently depending on whom you won the pit
fight with:

¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
      - YURI - [_SEVENTH KEY_], something you should save for the very end.
        ¯¯¯¯
     - ALICE - [_CRUCIFIX_], great in case you don't have 3 of them yet.
       ¯¯¯¯¯
   - ZHUZHEN - [_SILVER HAND_], temporary 100% on the Judgment Ring. Goes
     ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   great with that Seventh Key, or even the Fifth Keys.

 - MARGARETE - [_TISSUES_]. Pointless, unless you needed it for the Air
   ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Gravestone instead of using a Lottery Ticket.

     - KEITH - [_BELT OF THOR_], for a great ATK and P-ATK boost.
       ¯¯¯¯¯
    - HALLEY - [_METAL JACKET_], Halley's best armor.
      ¯¯¯¯¯¯
   - ALL SIX - [_CRYSTAL RING_] from Sharon, which reduces non-class damage
     ¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   by 50%.

It's time to decide which ending you want. If for some reason you want the bad
ending, then just skip this section. You'll also miss out on nine Monster
Library entries. If you want the good ending, then keep on reading.

  NOTE     TECHNICALLY, you can still get the Bad Ending even by defeating the
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Four Masks, but only if you forget to read the small tombstone in
           the Graveyard with Alice's name on it.

  NOTE     You really need to have gotten the Oath Grail from Joshua in the
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   London Rats' hideout before trying this. Otherwise, you're going to
           have a very tough time against the Masks. Also, Alice must be in
           your party for any of this to happen.

Follow these four steps to a tee (don't forget that there's one more step after
all the fighting), and you'll definitely get the good ending. Here we go:

1) Fight until your Malice meter is COMPLETELY red, meaning the Masks WILL
   attack you in random battles.

2) Read the Oath Grail in your Valuables menu; it shows that we need to defeat
   the Masks in the following order: Grail Mask, Gold Mask, Staff Mask, Sword
   Mask.

3) Encounter the Masks in this order. If one comes in out of order, run away
   and try again until the correct one appears. You'll know it's the correct
   one because it won't hit you with a ring anomaly that you cannot remedy.
   It's possible to beat them without fighting them in this order, but because
   of their Fast / Tight / Popping Shock abilities, it'll be very difficult.

  NOTE     If you encounter one of the Masks you already defeated between
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   fighting the full-strength ones in order, you can fight and defeat
           them without worry; the next full-strength Mask will still be
           weakened as if you fought them right after the previous Mask.

      .————————————.
     / * SUB-BOSS * \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Grail Mask            |  2000 HP  | Class: Water | [_] Amber Ring           |
| Gold Mask             |  2625 HP  | Class: Earth | [_] Carnelian Ring       |
| Staff Mask            |  2250 HP  | Class: Fire  | [_] Lazurite Ring        |
| Sword Mask            |  1875 HP  | Class: Wind  | [_] Obsidian Ring        |
|-----------------------|-----------|--------------|--------------------------|
| Grail Mask            |     1 HP  | Class: Water | [_] Thera Leaf           |
| Gold Mask             |     1 HP  | Class: Earth | [_] Thera Leaf           |
| Staff Mask            |     1 HP  | Class: Fire  | [_] Thera Leaf           |
| Sword Mask            |     1 HP  | Class: Wind  | [_] Thera Leaf           |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|                                                                             |
|  1st Encounter = Stronger form, must be fought in order for easy battles.   |
|  2nd Encounter = Weaker form, defeated once and have lost their powers.     |
|                                                                             |
|  1) Grail Mask - He's a joke. Your hit area will be DOUBLED, and he's       |
|     easily damaged by physical attacks. He should only take two turns, max. |
|                                                                             |
|  2) Gold Mask - A little harder than the Grail Mask, but not by much. He    |
|     can't be harmed by physical attacks, so you must take him out with      |
|     nothing but special attacks. It'll take longer than the Grail Mask, but |
|     he's not a threat at all.                                               |
|                                                                             |
|  3) Staff Mask - A little easier than the Gold Mask, but not by much. He's  |
|     just the opposite of the Gold Mask; he can't be harmed by special       |
|     attacks, so you must take him out with nothing but physical attacks, so |
|     it shouldn't be a problem. Again, not very much of a threat at this     |
|     point.                                                                  |
|                                                                             |
|  4) Sword Mask - The last of the Masks is actually almost as easy as the    |
|     first! He doesn't have any strong points like the last two, nor do you  |
|     have a wider hit area, but either way, it should only take two,         |
|     possibly three rounds to take this one out.                             |
|                                                                             |
|  5) Round Two! - Once you have defeated all Four Masks, keep your Malice    |
|     in the red and wait for them to come around to fight once more! This    |
|     time around, they don't need to be fought in any order, and they only   |
|     take one hit to die. Make sure to do this so you get all eight of their |
|     entries for the Monster Library.                                        |
|                                                                             |
| .————————————————.—————————————.—————————————.—————————————.—————————————.  |

| |————————————————|—————————————|—————————————|—————————————|—————————————|  |
| |   Grail Mask   |    45000    |    30000    |      10     |      10     |  |
| |   Gold Mask    |    45000    |    30000    |      10     |      10     |  |
| |   Staff Mask   |    45000    |    30000    |      10     |      10     |  |
| |   Sword Mask   |    45000    |    30000    |      10     |      10     |  |
| '————————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'—————————————'  |

There is one last step that is CRITICAL, and very easy to miss.

4) Go to the Graveyard and examine the tiny tombstone next to the Dark
   Gravestone; it should read "Rest in peace, Alice Elliot...". If you do not
   read this, then Yuri won't know that anything is happening in the coming
   events and won't join in. While you're there, feel free to clear the
   remainder of your Malice.

the good ending or not!

Head into Roger's house and talk to him, and he'll have you rest up while he
works on the teleporter. In the meantime, you'll regain control of Alice in
Yuri's Graveyard. Read the tombstones if you like, then go talk to the Masks.

god of death. One of two things here will now happen:

1) Alice will enter a battle with Atman, alone. This is what will happen if you
   chose the follow the path to the bad ending. You cannot defeat Atman, and
   after a few turns, he'll cast Eradication and defeat Alice in battle, at
   which point you'll wake back up and regain control in Roger's house.

2) Yuri will come in, and he and Alice both will battle Atman. Here we go...

After the battle, watch the quick scene (and cut-scene, if you defeated Atman),
then you'll regain control.

If you defeated Atman with both Yuri and Alice, there's one more item we can
grab. Before talking to Roger, head back out onto the World Map and choose to
go into the Graveyard. Talk to the Masks here for an event, where you'll
receive the [_SEVEN-EYED MASK_]. Also, to confirm that you are getting the good
ending, read the small tombstone beside the Dark Gravestone; it should now say
"Atman, rest in peace..."

Back in the Nemeton Monastery, talk to Roger. (You may have a sequence
involving the Erotic Book and Pulse Tract first before the story moves on; see
W-S-16 below for the full details.) He'll be finished, and asks you if you wish
to go to Neameeto.

   [2] Let's go!
———————————————————————————————————————————

(If you choose 1, you may see that Roger is Lottery Member No. 00; see W-S-16
below for the full details.) When you're ready, choose 2 and you'll have to
complete a Spin Ring _5_ (that's right, 15 targets) to have Roger successfully
send you off!


   Neameeto
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
You've made it! However, now that we've completed the Atman sequence and
stepped foot on Neameeto, we can take on the very last bit of side quests. If
you don't want to do it, skip down to W-2-16 - Final Preparations. Otherwise,
step on the yellow circle in this room to be sent back down to the Nemeton
Monastery!

After completing the Atman events, talk to Roger in the Nemeton Monastery;
he'll notice the Erotic Book you have, and will give you the [_PULSE TRACT_] in
exchange for it!

Talk to Roger again, and he'll want help for an experiment. The help? The
dreaded Spin Ring _10_! Yes, _30_ hits on the Judgment Ring! Personally, I was
able to get it in two tries (the first time I missed the very last one), but
keep at it, and you'll eventually hit them all. Try your best not to break your
TV, your controller, your PS2, ANYTHING. Stay calm and focused, and you should
do it. By completing it, you'll receive Yuri's best weapon, the
[_NIGHTBIRD CLAW_].

Next, SAVE YOUR GAME! Then talk to Roger again, and he'll ask if you wish to go
to Neameeto.

previous members, you'll find out that Roger is Lottery Member No. 00, the
Chairman!

Nothing strange about the ring here, just really small hit areas! Make sure to
win both the CottonUnderpants and Comet Mask before continuing on; the
CottonUnderpants is an accessory for Alice that increases her physical defense
AND cuts normal attack damage in half (and change the color of her panties from
pink to white!), while the Comet Mask increases P-Def, S-Def, and P-Avd when
equipped, and can't be obtained anywhere else. If you don't win what you want,
reload your last save and try again.

Now that we've met all the Lottery Members, feel free to waste your remaining
tickets on whichever Lottery Members you like! I recommend Seals of the Soul
for your lower SP party members, mainly Alice, as well as some of the other
Seals, and some of the ultimate recovery items like the TalismanOfPower, which
revives an ally completely when used.

If for some reason Roger doesn't show up as being the next Lottery Member, then
you missed someone. Here are the locations of all of the Lottery Members in the
game; you can't do anything about the ones in China, but you can check with all
of the ones here in Europe to make sure you didn't miss any:


   Asia

Now that we're finished with the Lottery, we need to move on to the very last
side quest of them all: the Seraphic Radiance.

Examine the Pulse Tract that you received from Roger; it depicts a new path
through the Ancient Ruins, so that's where we're headed.


   Ancient Ruins
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
Enter the maze, then take the following paths:

 - YELLOW    (left room)
 - RED       (left room)
 - GREEN     (center room)
 - VIOLET    (right room)
 - BLUE      (left room)
 - RED       (center room)
 - TURQUOISE (right room)

After you reach the very last area, be back at the beginning. Descend the
stairs here and walk up to the altar; you'll find a chest containing the
[_STONE OF REBIRTH_]. Make your way out of the Ancient Ruins and back onto the
World Map. SAVE YOUR GAME and enter the Graveyard for the last time.

   Graveyard
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
  NOTE     The next battle is EXTREMELY difficult, as it will be with Yuri
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   alone. I recommend doing the following things before attempting to
           fight:

           - Put Yuri in the back row.

           - Put both the Brsrkr Earrings and the Seven-Eyed Mask (or
             Comet Mask) on him to boost his HP and defense, respectively.

           - Equip the Mind's Eye on him, unless you're still taking more
             damage in two rounds that you can't heal on. If that's the case,
             equip a Voodoo Doll; it'll boost your S-Def a bit more AND revive
             Yuri once if he dies.

           - Stock up on Thera Extracts (Silent Peddler).

           - Buy some Third Keys to help speed the battle along. (optional)

Go through the northern gate, then go as far as you can north to examine the
sunset. Attempt to leave, and you'll encounter Ben Hyuga. After some discussion
about him and the Seraphic Radiance, you'll have to face him in an attempt to
conquer and capture the god.

|  | Stygian Robe      |   Malcto will hit Yuri for major damage while also   |
|  | Mind's Eye        |   healing itself! That's its only special attack;    |
|  | Brsrkr Earrings   |   the only other thing it does is its attack, and    |
|  | Comet Mask        |   it hits HARD! If you're not in the back row, you   |
|  |                   |   better shift there immediately. As long as you're  |
|  | Amon              |   in the back row, you should be able to attack      |
|  | Lobo              |   two, possibly three times in a row before you      |
|  | Forron            |   will have to heal with a Thera Root or,            |
|  '———————————————————'   preferably, a Thera Extract.                       |
|                                                                             |
|  Fuse into Amon, or if you need some spare SP, then Lobo (since he has the  |
|  2nd highest P-Def at this point, as well as the same P-Atk as Amon). All   |
|  you'll be doing is physically attacking a round or two, then healing the   |
|  next. Yep, that's it... pretty boring actually, but any other route will   |
|  likely get you killed. Trust me, it's worth it.                            |
|                                                                             |
|  If you find yourself in trouble, try using Third Keys to help dish out     |
|  damage when you have an opportunity to. If you're STILL having trouble     |
|  with him, then you'll just have to level up and try again.                 |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   60000 EXP   / \   99999 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

Once he's defeated, you'll earn Yuri's final fusion, the [_SERAPHICRADIANCE_].
Watch the cut-scene here, and when you regain control, return to the  tree
where you fought Ben. Open a chest behind the tree, and you'll find Yuri's best
armor, his [_FATHER'S COAT_].





=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=—=

That's it for all the side quests. Let's go to Neameeto and end this.

¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

Just want to run a few last suggestions by you before you go on to finish...

 - Cash in all of your steps with the Silent Peddler. I recommend stocking up
   on Thera Extracts. (If you're going to be grinding for levels, be sure to
   equip the Pedometer and Accelerator while you're doing it; you can easily
   earn enough steps to buy whatever you like.)

 - Spend the money using Meiyuan's Acupuncture to increase the Hit Area and/or
   Attack Power of your ultimate weapons.

 - Stock up on the following items, if you have the cash and/or steps. If you
   had ground everyone to get their final special skills, you should have a ton
   of both. (The Third Keys make for MUCH easier boss battles. And yes, these
   quantities are probably a bit high. Better safe than sorry.)

   - If you don't have the extra money for Extracts right now, the enemies in
     Neameeto can drop them, so if you have those sets of Pirate Earrings, you
     can get them to drop 100% if you equip 5 of them, or 4 of them and the
     Thief Earrings.

   - Thera Extract (50+ from the Silent Peddler)
   - Mana Root (50+ from Roger's Vending Machine)
   - Mana Extract (10-15 or so from the Tight-lipped Merchant in Prague)
   - Pure Root (25 or so from the Tight-lipped Merchant in Prague)
   - Pure Extract (5-10 or so from the Tight-lipped Merchant in Prague)
   - Third Keys (5-10 or so from the Tight-lipped Merchant in Prague)

 - Learn all of Yuri's ???? Fusion skills by going Berserk in battle, fused as
   the monster you want to learn the ability with.

 - If you want to, you can grind everyone to the following levels to have all
   of their special skills. Here in Neameeto is the best place for EXP and Gold
   in the game.

    - Alice - 48
    - Zhuzhen - 47
    - Margarete - 46
    - Keith - 49
    - Halley - 47

    - Grinding Equipment Suggestions (to maximize Steps, Cash, and EXP)

      - Brigand Earrings x6, 1 per party member (purchased in Asia)
      - Thief Earrings x1, equip on ANY party member (won from Lottery)
      - Pedometer x1, equip on an active party member (from Silent Peddler)
      - Accelerator x1, equip with the Pedometer (won from Lottery)
      - Monk Earrings x2, active party members to boost EXP (Olga/Orphanage)

      - This should give you +140% Cash, Double Pedometer steps, and +40%
        EXP for those two who have the Monk Earrings equipped.

 - Make sure everyone (yes, all six members) has their best equipment AND a set
   of accessories equipped. Also, make sure they're at LEAST level 40 or higher
   before moving on. There's a point in Neameeto that your party is split in
   two, and your preferred party may not be the one doing the fighting. I
   strongly recommend leveling until they have their final skills as mentioned
   above.

Once you feel you've done everything you want to do, head to Neameeto to finish
what we've started...

  NOTE     You can leave Neameeto at any time by using the yellow warp points
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   to return to Earth.

Make your way up the stairs to the east. As the path forks, continue west,
following the path to the next area. Move up to and examine the red beams here,
and you'll be told that you cannot pass. Head back to the last fork and make
your way up the stairs to the north.

Follow the path to the next room, where your party will split up to search.
Yuri causes the beams to come down, but by doing so ends up grapping himself,
so now you must choose a party of the remaining members, minus Yuri and another
        party member. (I ended up using Alice, Zhuzhen, and Halley.)

Go back out to the fork and head west back to the beams, which are now gone, so
you can continue west to the next area. Keep climbing the stairs until you
reach a room with three paths and a glowing triangle button in the center of
the room. Choose option 2 here to release the beams around Yuri.

As Yuri, make your way back out to the fork and wall the way west to meet back
with your party. After you re-choose your party, take the northern path to the
next area, following along to the next area as well.

  NOTE     Put your party in the back row; you can't physically attack in the
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   next battle.

When you're ready, approach the beast in the center of the area that blocks
your way.

  NOTE     Now that this boss has been defeated, some of the best music in the
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   game now plays: Star Shape. Ah.... Oh, and yeah, there's now a
           Save Point here, as well as a yellow warp point to go back to Earth,
           and a pink party formation point to change your party. Feel free to
           use them as you please.

Use the Save Point, then head northwest and climb the short stairs here to come
to a chest containing a [_SEAL OF AURA_]. Go back down the short stairs, but
follow this walkway down as it goes counter clockwise, and you'll find the last
[_LOTTERY TICKET_] in the game. Return to the center and take the upper-right
path, following it straight up another short staircase to find some
[_BRSRKR EARRINGS_].

Return to the center area once again and take the middle-right path to the
walkway, all the way to a thin green beam going up. Walk through it to activate
it, then go back to the center area, then south back down to the previous floor
to the fork with the glowing triangle button. Go down and take the western path
now, and the green beam that was once here is now gone, allowing you to get the
[_CRANK SLINGSHOT_] out of the chest here. Return back to the second floor and
to the center area.

Use the Points again if you like, then take the upper-right path once again,
then continue up the stairs to the left. Of the two paths here, take the one on
the right first to the next area. At the four-way fork here, go northwest and
open the chest here for a [_SEAL OF VITALITY_], then go back to the fork and
head northeast, where you'll come across another beam going up. Walk through
the blue beam to activate it, then return back to the previous room with the
Points.

Make your way back to the center area, then take the middle-right path once
again, this time climbing the stairs one set above the ones to the lower-right,
and continue northeast to the next area. At the fork here, take the lower-right
path and run through the red beam to activate it, then go back and take the
upper-left path that is now open where the blue beams once were, following the
path to a dead-end with two chests; a [_SILVERTHREADCOAT_] and a
[_SAGE STAFF_].

Return to the center area with the Points one last time. SAVE YOUR GAME, then
take the northeastern path once again. At the two northern doors, take the
western one this time to the next area. At the fork here, go northeast to
another dead-end, but also with two more chests; a [_RUBBER SUIT_], and more
[_MONK EARRINGS_]. Make your way back out to the fork.

  NOTE     Equip Crucifixes on each of your party members for the next boss.
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
When you're ready, head northwest and up the stairs, where Hate will be waiting
for you.

After the battle, the same three Points will appear once again, so Save, then
continue up the stairs to the north to the next area. Keep following along
through two corridors until you reach a new room and a staircase. Climb the
stairs to the next area, where you'll be warped to a different location of the
castle.

  NOTE     In this area, try to get some TalismansOfPower from the Red Caps.
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
After a quick discussion among the group, head up the northern stairs to the
next area, warping once again. Climb the short yellow stairs to the north, then
head west to a fork of stairs; go up the stairs, then walk to the left as far
as you can to warp to the next area. Open the chest to your right for the
[_HERETIC'S COAT_], then return through the warp to the previous area.

Return to the fork of stairs and descend the other set, then follow the path as
it goes south to the next area. Follow the path here until you warp once again.
Go west from here to find a hidden chest on this balcony that contains a
[_MIND'S EYE_], then descend the stairs here to warp once again. Follow this
path west and through a door to return to the area where you first warped to.

Head north once again to the next area and follow the path to the warp, once
again. Climb the short yellow stairs, but this time, go east and southeast to
warp back to the very first warp, but on the other side. Open the chest on this
platform for a [_TALISMANOFPOWER_], then go west to the next area.

DO NOT GO UNDERNEATH THE STAIRS TO THE NORTHWEST, or you'll have to start over
again! Instead, climb the stairs here, opening the chest above you for a
[_V-BLADE-BLODAUTH_]. Continue climbing to find another warp, which will let
you open the chest you saw earlier; it has a [_FIFTH KEY_]. That's it for
treasure, so take a few steps west to warp for the last time, then head north
across the bridge to the next area.

When you're ready, approach the freaky looking demon that's waiting for you.

|        |                    |     Alice [57]   |                   |        |
|        |====================|==================|===================|        |
|        | Nightbird Claw     | Holy Book-Flesh  | 10 Gauge          |        |
|        | Father's Coat      | GoldThreadCoat   | Leather Suit      |        |
|        | Mind's Eye         | CottonUnderpants | Mind's Eye        |        |
|        | Will Power         | Will Power       | Will Power        |        |
|        | Crucifix           | Crucifix         | Crucifix          |        |
|        |                    |                  |                   |        |
|        | SeraphicRadiance   |                  |                   |        |
|        | Amon               |                  |                   |        |
|        | Sandalphon         |                  |                   |        |
|        '———————————————————'———————————————————'———————————————————'        |
|                                                                             |
|  This is easily the greatest battle music of all time: Imbroglio!!!         |
|                                                                             |
|  He'll start off with Time of Judgment, which will do major damage to your  |
|  entire party, but will also take away some MP. Each of his colored Abyss   |
|  attacks will hit your party for pretty decent damage, but if you're not    |
|  wearing a Crucifix, then it will also inflict you with a status            |
|  abnormality, depending on the class. He'll also use Nine Springs, which    |
|  works like !!! in that it reduces your HP to 1, so be sure to heal after   |
|  it hits.                                                                   |
|                                                                             |
|  Don't bother boosting your party with For Tomorrow or anything like that;  |
|  he'll use Light of Deprivation to remove it all before you even get a      |
|  chance to enjoy it.                                                        |
|                                                                             |
|  Since this is the final battle, Yuri gets to have a ton of fun with the    |
|  items we've been holding on to! Start off by fusing him into the           |
|  SeraphicRadiance, then have use the Silver Hand item on himself, giving    |
|  him a 100% ring area. On his second turn, have him use a Monkey Paw on     |
|  himself, which will triple his attack! Before his third turn, have         |
|  someone in your party use a Moon Swallow (or just a Star Swallow on Yuri)  |
|  to make all attacks critical attacks!                                      |
|                                                                             |
|  Finally, on his third, fourth, and fifth turns, have him use the two       |
|  Seventh Keys and a Fifth Key. Just press the CROSS button as fast as you   |
|  can while you have the 100% ring area to land EVERY HIT! This should       |
|  DEFINITELY be enough to take out God. If not, once the Silver Hand wears   |
|  off, either attack normally for a few rounds, or try out the remaining     |
|  Fifth Keys to keep wailing on him. Remember, each attack that says 999 HP  |
|  damages is more than likely doing more than 999. The damage itself         |
|  doesn't cap; just the displayed number.                                    |
|                                                                             |
|  In the meantime, Alice should be casting Arc every single round, and       |
|  Margarete should be helping Alice. If healing isn't needed, then use       |
|  Advent with Alice and normal attacks with Third or Fifth Keys with         |
|  Margarete.                                                                 |
|                                                                             |
|  If for some reason you don't have those items, than you can work on him    |
|  like the last few bosses. As usual, fuse Yuri into the SeraphicRadiance    |
|  and start physically attacking, using any Keys you do have. The girls      |
|  should be doing the same thing as listed above; just stay healed and be    |
|  patient.                                                                   |
|                                                                             |
'—————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————'

¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯

By saving your clear data after beating the game and watching the credits, you
can now use that clear data to play the game in New Game+ mode. There are a few
benefits to playing in New Game+ mode:

1) You start the game with every Fusion that you earned the last game,
   including both Amon and the SeraphicRadiance.

2) Your Score (in the Command Menu) carries over on the right side, and you can
   compare your Score for this game against the one you earned last game.

3) If you have all 124 Monster Library entries from your last game (or even a
   combination of your last and current games), you can talk to Knowledgeable
   Carl when Sharon's Pit Fight becomes available, and he will give you the
   [_BLACKSILKPANTS_]. It is an accessory for Alice that increases her special
   defense and cuts special attack damage in half (and changes the color of her
   panties from pink to black!)

Mind's Eyes / Weird Bottles / etc. equipped isn't possible.

make it run normally, but it has no effect this time, so it'll probably take

continuing on; it's arguably the best accessory in the game. It will make the
areas on your Judgment Ring invisible, but it'll DOUBLE (yes, DOUBLE) your

widened on them, (or if you're just that good at Yuri's ring) Yuri becomes
ridiculously overpowered.

Location: Rouen (Fake-nose Man)

The ring here moves REALLY fast. And in addition to that, the hit areas are
pretty small. Normally, equipping the Pocket Watch would make it run normally,
but it has no effect this time, so it'll probably take you QUITE a few tries to
get this. This guy is special for one reason: Once you win the 10 Gauge for
Margarete, he will revert back to Lottery Member No. 06.

 - The Eye of Ouroboros fully Restores MP and SP when used. You may want to get
   a few of these, as they'll come in handy in the final battles.

 - The Seal of Strength increases your strength, obviously. I don't think they
   ever really benefit your party members THAT much, so avoid getting them
   UNLESS you've already bought all you like with your Lottery Tickets and have
   extra to spend.

 - The Dice of Caesar allow some of your allies to gain 3x strength in battle,
   but can miss some or all of your party sometimes. I avoid these just because
   it's not a guaranteed boost in battle, but some others may find it useful.

 - The 10 Gauge is Margarete's best weapon; make sure to win it, but save it
   for last. You may even want to wait on getting this until you visit the
   remaining Lottery Members, depending on how many of these middle three items
   you may want.

Listed here are all of the sub-bosses and bosses in the game, as well as the
strategies to defeat them. This section is listed in the order that they were
encountered within the walkthrough.


      .————————————.
     / * SUB-BOSS * \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Raging Tiger          |    75 HP  | Class: Earth |                          |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|                                                                             |
|  Hey, we can win this one! Go ahead and use Yuri's Fusion skill to become   |
|  the Death Emperor, then use normal attacks to wipe out the Raging Tiger.   |
|  He's not tough at all, and should take just a couple turns to take out.    |
|                                                                             |
'—————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————'


      .————————————.
     / * SUB-BOSS * \

|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|                                                                             |
|  They're not too bad; just have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger and wail    |
|  on them with regular attacks while Alice keeps both of you healed with     |
|  either Cure or Thera Leaves.                                               |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'

      .————————————.
     / * SUB-BOSS * \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Felinus               |   250 HP  | Class: Wind  | [_] Lottery Ticket       |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|                                                                             |
|  This lady isn't to be taken lightly. She can use the Wind Fang ability to  |
|  hit everyone for Wind damage, and after a couple of turns, your whole      |
|  party will be in need of healing, so beware.                               |
|                                                                             |
|  Since she's a Wind class, have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger and use     |
|  the Flying Stones skill to do some decent damage to her, followed by       |
|  regular attack. Alice should be keeping everyone healed, as should         |
|  Zhuzhen. If no one needs healing then, have Zhuzhen use his Ogre           |
|  Flamedance spell, and Alice should attack normally. As long as you stay    |
|  healed and don't let Alice go Berserk, you should be fine.                 |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   00120 EXP   / \   00600 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'


      .————————————.
     / *** BOSS *** \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Yamaraja: Earth       |   300 HP  | Class: Water | [_] Star Brooch          |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|        .———————————————————.———————————————————.———————————————————.        |
|        |     Yuri [07]     |                   |                   |        |
|        |                   |     Alice [06]    |    Zhuzhen [06]   |        |
|        |===================|===================|===================|        |
|        | Leather Gloves    | Small Bible       | Oak Staff         |        |
|        | Cotton Shirt      | Cotton Blouse     | Cotton Shirt      |        |
|        | Bandanna          | Bandanna          | Bandanna          |        |
|        | Leather Belt      | Leather Belt      | Leather Belt      |        |
|        |                   |                   |                   |        |
|        | Death Emperor     |                   |                   |        |
|        | Raging Tiger      |                   |                   |        |
|        '———————————————————'———————————————————'———————————————————'        |
|                                                                             |
|  Note that Yamaraja: Earth is actually a WATER class. As I mentioned        |
|  above, he's pretty dangerous! If you can't beat him, level up in town for  |
|  a while before trying again. I recommend at least level 6 for everyone.    |
|                                                                             |
|  His Flash Flood will hit an ally for pretty good damage, while his Large   |
|  Whirlpool will hit your entire party for major damage, as well as          |
|  possibly halving your Hit Area on your Ring, so be sure to heal after it   |
|  hits. His physical attacks are also nothing to sneeze at, as they can      |
|  take away large chunks of HP at a time. Make sure that Alice and Zhuzhen   |
|  are in the back row, and when in doubt, just heal.                         |
|                                                                             |
|  Have Yuri fuse into the Raging Tiger and use his Flying Stones attack,     |
|  followed by normal attacks. Have Alice stay on healing duty the entire     |
|  time, and have Zhuzhen cast Ogre Flamedance continuously. If needed, have  |
|  Yuri supplement healing since Zhuzhen's fire magic probably hits for more  |
|  than Yuri does, and make sure to keep Alice from becoming Berserk.         |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   00180 EXP   / \   01800 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

|  to do some extra damage to the Water Tiger once the Kappas are gone, have  |

|  Water Tiger.                                                               |
|                                                                             |

|                                                                             |

|  damage. Have Alice keep everyone's HP up during the battle, having         |

|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|        .———————————————————.———————————————————.———————————————————.        |

|        | Leather Vest      | Leather Skirt     | Leather Vest      |        |
|        | Leather Cap       | Leather Cap       | Leather Cap       |        |
|        | Casual Belt       | Casual Belt       | Casual Belt       |        |
|        | Jade Lariat       | Shell Bracelet    | Star Brooch       |        |

|        | Heaven's Fiend    |                   |                   |        |
|        | Tornado           |                   |                   |        |
|        '———————————————————'———————————————————'———————————————————'        |
|                                                                             |
|  Note that Yamaraja: Wind is actually an EARTH class, so make sure not to   |
|  fuse into the Raging Tiger.                                                |
|                                                                             |
|  Its Shockwave attack will do decent damage to each character, while its    |
|  Flying Stones attack will do major damage, but to only one character.      |
|  However, its PHYSICAL attacks are the ones you have to worry about; it     |
|  can do a three hit attack that will easily kill a party member, even if    |
|  they're in the back row, so be sure to stay healed.                        |
|                                                                             |
|  If you have the Tornado Fusion, have Yuri fuse into that; otherwise, have  |
|  him fuse into the Death Emperor. Use his Wind Shear/Dark Messenger Spells  |
|  continuously; if he runs out of MP, have either him or someone else        |
|  replenish it so he can keep dishing out the damage. Have Margarete on      |
|  healing duty, using Thera Leaves on whoever needs them, as well as using   |
|  Mana Leaves on Yuri and Zhuzhen to keep their MP up. Have Zhuzhen use his  |
|  Ogre Flamedance continuously, stopping to heal if someone needs it.        |
|                                                                             |
|  Yuri should be doing the most damage if he has the Tornado Fusion, so      |
|  keep his MP up while keeping everyone else healed.                         |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   00720 EXP   / \   03600 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'


      .————————————.
     / * SUB-BOSS * \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Li Li                 |   580 HP  | Class: Dark  | [_] W.Tiger Hair         |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|                                                                             |
|  This is just a warm-up, so try to avoid using TOO much MP if possible for  |
|  the next boss battle.                                                      |
|                                                                             |
|  She can and will use Dark Messenger, which not only deals major damage,    |
|  but can instantly kill a party member, so be careful. Her other attacks    |
|  are Paralysis (which does decent damage, but you should be guarded         |
|  against the actual Paralysis effect with your Rosewood Bracelets) and a    |
|  normal attack, which you shouldn't need to worry about.                    |
|                                                                             |
|  If you have it, have Yuri use Heaven's Fiend and use the Exorcist Arrow    |
|  attack; it should do MAJOR damage. Alice should cast Holy Edge on          |
|  Margarete first, so she has Light-based attacks, then she should cast      |
|  Blessed Light. Margaret should just be attacking normally, using Thera     |
|  and Mana Leaves whenever the party's HP/MP are getting low. If you really  |
|  need a second healer, Heaven's Fiend is perfect for the role, as its       |
|  Sacred Remedy will heal EVERYONE in the party.                             |
|                                                                             |
|  If you don't have Heaven's Fiend, have Yuri fuse into either Inferno or    |
|  Raging Tiger (they are your two physically strongest Fusions at this       |
|  point) and use normal attacks on her. If he has Inferno, use the Fighting  |
|  Spirit skill first to increase his attack, then start wailing away on      |
|  her. Alice should cast Holy Edge on Yuri first, so he has Light-based      |
|  attacks, then she should cast Blessed Light. Margaret should just be       |
|  attacking normally, using Thera and Mana Leaves whenever the party's       |
|  HP/MP are getting low. Not much to worry about (other than Dark            |
|  Messenger) here.                                                           |
|                                                                             |
'——.—————————————————.——————————————————.—————————————————————————————————————'
    \   00800 EXP   / \   03800 Cash   /
     '—————————————'   '——————————————'

|  against the actual Paralysis effect with your Rosewood Bracelets.) Watch   |
|  out for Hate Storm, as it'll do decent damage to your whole party.         |
|                                                                             |
|  Start off by healing, if needed. As with the last battle, if you have it,  |
|  have Yuri use Heaven's Fiend and use the Exorcist Arrow attack; it should  |
|  do MAJOR damage. Alice should cast Holy Edge on Margarete first, so she    |
|  has Light-based attacks, then she should cast Blessed Light. Margaret      |
|  should just be attacking normally, using Thera and Mana Leaves whenever    |
|  the party's HP/MP are getting low. If you really need a second healer,     |
|  Heaven's Fiend is perfect for the role, as its Sacred Remedy will heal     |
|  EVERYONE in the party, especially after Hate Storm.                        |
|                                                                             |
|  If you don't have Heaven's Fiend, have Yuri fuse into either Inferno or    |
|  Raging Tiger (they are your two physically strongest Fusions at this       |
|  point) and use normal attacks on her. If he has Inferno, use the Fighting  |
|  Spirit skill first to increase his attack, then start wailing away on      |
|  her. Alice should cast Holy Edge on Yuri first, so he has Light-based      |
|  attacks, then she should cast Blessed Light REPEATEDLY. Margaret will be   |
|  the primary healer once again, as Yuri and Alice should be shelling out    |
|  some pretty wicked damage to Li Li. Use Thera and Mana Leaves whenever     |
|  the party's HP/MP are getting low, and you should be fine.                 |

|  damage.                                                                    |

|  free round, have him use Ogre Flamedance, since it'll still do some okay   |

|  equipped definitely helps a ton. You don't want to be stuck with NO        |

|                                                                             |
|  Not much of a strategy here, since there's only one thing you can do:      |
|  Attack. Have Alice be the preferred healer, using Thera Seeds and such,    |
|  since her attack is the weakest. Keep hammering away, and as long as you   |
|  stay healed, Baigu will eventually fall.                                   |
|                                                                             |

|                                                                             |
|  Yamaraja will most likely start off with the Crimson Flame spell, dealing  |
|  MAJOR fire damage to your party and possibly Silencing them as well. His   |
|  Petrification attack should only do medium damage to your party IF you're  |
|  protected against it; otherwise, you'll turn to stone, and three           |
|  Petrified party members equals a game over. He'll also use a Shockwave     |
|  attack, but it only does a small amount of damage to your whole party.     |
|  His physical attacks are nothing to sneeze at either; a series of three    |
|  attacks will do MAJOR damage to a party member.                            |
|                                                                             |
|  As much as I hate to say this, Yuri will need to be the primary healer of  |
|  this battle, as he's the only one that has a heal-all spell, and without   |
|  it, it will be hard to keep up with the healing with just two party        |
|  members. Fuse him into the Heaven's Fiend, then cast Sacred Remedy if      |
|  your party needs healing, and if they don't, then use Exorcist Arrow.      |
|  Zhuzhen should be constantly casting Life Sucker, and Margarete should be  |
|  using Snipe. When the party's MP starts getting low, have Margarete use    |
|  Mana Seeds to boost them back up.                                          |
|                                                                             |
|  Due to the sheer amount of HP Yamaraja has, and the fact that your main    |
|  damage dealer is on healing duty, prepare for a very long battle. You'll   |
|  most likely need to use at least two Pure Seeds to keep Zhuzhen's and      |
|  Margarete's SP up.                                                         |
|                                                                             |

|                                                                             |
|  Olga's Black Fog attack will do MAJOR damage to your party, as well as     |
|  Poison each one of them, so it's a good idea to come in with Shell or      |
|  Cosmic Bracelets equipped. Her Nova attack will do decent damage to a      |
|  single ally, her Icy Breath attack will hit your whole party for decent    |
|  damage, and her physical attack just does pathetic damage to a single      |
|  ally. Watch out if she uses Mind Assault to steal your MP, as you'll want  |
|  to recover it immediately if she takes too much.                           |
|                                                                             |
|  Yuri and Alice are obvious choices for this battle, and you could pretty   |
|  much pick whomever your favorite is, as they'll all do roughly the same    |
|  amount of damage. I recommend Margarete just because I had her at a        |
|  higher level than Keith and Zhuzhen, therefore having more STR and HP.     |
|  That, and I find Margarete's Ring easier to hit than Keith's. Zhuzhen      |
|  just sucks up a lot of MP and takes extra turns to replenish it. Okay,     |
|  okay, I really like her too, if that matters any.                          |
|                                                                             |
|  Fuse Yuri into Baldo (if you didn't get his level 2 Light Fusion, then     |
|  fuse into the Heaven's Fiend, as you'll need the healing) and start        |
|  physically attacking; with the Mind's Eye equipped, he'll be doing major   |
|  damage. If you didn't put the Mind's Eye on him, then go with the Nova     |
|  spell instead.                                                             |
|                                                                             |
|  Have Alice cast Holy Edge on Yuri her first round so he can keep piling    |
|  the damage up, then have her cast it on Margarete her second turn so she   |
|  can start adding in to the damage. Margarete should also be attacking      |
|  normally. If for some reason Alice doesn't need to heal, have her cast     |

|  it, have Alice and Margarete do it. If all three need it, then have Yuri   |
|  do it, as Olga doesn't mess around, and can easily kill your entire party  |

|  can do anything about it efficiently.                                      |

|  Rather than list each sub-boss separately, I'm covering them all in this   |
|  one section, since each one requires basically the same strategy.          |
|                                                                             |
|  Each of their HP varies depending on Yuri, so if he's weaker, they'll be   |
|  weaker as well, and vice versa.                                            |
|                                                                             |
|  If you want to use the Mind's Eye, just fuse into Amon and wail on them    |
|  for a few rounds, making sure to heal if necessary.                        |
|                                                                             |
|  If you don't want to use the Mind's Eye, fuse into the highest level       |
|  monster that is the opposite class of the one you're fighting. Make sure   |

      .————————————.
     / * SUB-BOSS * \
.———'————————————————'——.———————————.——————————————.——————————————————————————.
| Grail Mask            |  2000 HP  | Class: Water | [_] Amber Ring           |
| Gold Mask             |  2625 HP  | Class: Earth | [_] Carnelian Ring       |
| Staff Mask            |  2250 HP  | Class: Fire  | [_] Lazurite Ring        |
| Sword Mask            |  1875 HP  | Class: Wind  | [_] Obsidian Ring        |
|-----------------------|-----------|--------------|--------------------------|
| Grail Mask            |     1 HP  | Class: Water | [_] Thera Leaf           |
| Gold Mask             |     1 HP  | Class: Earth | [_] Thera Leaf           |
| Staff Mask            |     1 HP  | Class: Fire  | [_] Thera Leaf           |
| Sword Mask            |     1 HP  | Class: Wind  | [_] Thera Leaf           |
|———————————————————————'———————————'——————————————'——————————————————————————|
|                                                                             |
|  1st Encounter = Stronger form, must be fought in order for easy battles.   |
|  2nd Encounter = Weaker form, defeated once and have lost their powers.     |
|                                                                             |
|  1) Grail Mask - He's a joke. Your hit area will be DOUBLED, and he's       |
|     easily damaged by physical attacks. He should only take two turns, max. |
|                                                                             |
|  2) Gold Mask - A little harder than the Grail Mask, but not by much. He    |
|     can't be harmed by physical attacks, so you must take him out with      |
|     nothing but special attacks. It'll take longer than the Grail Mask, but |
|     he's not a threat at all.                                               |
|                                                                             |
|  3) Staff Mask - A little easier than the Gold Mask, but not by much. He's  |
|     just the opposite of the Gold Mask; he can't be harmed by special       |
|     attacks, so you must take him out with nothing but physical attacks, so |
|     it shouldn't be a problem. Again, not very much of a threat at this     |
|     point.                                                                  |
|                                                                             |
|  4) Sword Mask - The last of the Masks is actually almost as easy as the    |
|     first! He doesn't have any strong points like the last two, nor do you  |
|     have a wider hit area, but either way, it should only take two,         |
|     possibly three rounds to take this one out.                             |
|                                                                             |
|  5) Round Two! - Once you have defeated all Four Masks, keep your Malice    |
|     in the red and wait for them to come around to fight once more! This    |
